mthong lam gyi snga rol du mthong spang spangs pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom la chags bral sngon song med de/ mthong lam gyi snga rol du srid rtse la chags bral byas pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir chags bral sngon du song ba dang*/ dgra bcom gyi gzhi mthun yin pa tsam gyis chags bral sngon du song ba'i dgra bcom yin mi dgos te/ phyir 'ong dang zhugs pa'i gzhi mthun yin pa tsam gyis phyir 'ong zhugs pa yin mi dgos pa bzhin/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya'i gtso bor mthong lam gyi snga rol tu ma spangs pa'i zhugs gnas gang rung de/ chags bral sngon du ma song ba'i spang bya rim gyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ rgyun zhugs zhugs gnas dang*/ phyir 'ong zhugs gnas gnyis/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs gnas gnyis/ dgra bcom zhugs gnas gnyis te brgyad/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba'o// mtshan nyid ni/ mthong spangs tsam spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge tshul gyi 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson bzhin pa'i dman pa'i gang zag gang zhig sbyor lam rten gcig pa dang*/ bden pa mngon rtogs skad cig dang po bco lnga gang rung la gnas pa de/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang*/ chos kyi rjes 'brang gnyis/ dad pa tsam gyis bden pa mngon par rtogs pa la sbyor ba'i gang zag de/ spyir dad pa'i rjes 'brang gi mtshan nyid/ pha rol gyis bstan pa la mi ltos par rang nyid kyi shes rab kyis bden pa mngon par rtogs pa la sbyor ba'i gang zag de/ spyir chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i mtshan nyid/ spyir rjes 'brang tsam 'di nyid la dbye na/ rgyun zhugs zhugs par gyur pa'i rjes 'brang gnyis/ phyir 'ongs zhugs par gyur pa'i rjes 'brang gnyis/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs par gyur pa'i rjes 'brang gnyis te drug go /mtshan nyid ni/ phyir 'ong zhugs pa gang zhig

dad pa tsam gyis bden pa mngon par rtogs pa la sbyor ba zhes sogs rigs bsgre bar bya'o// mthong spangs tsam spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu la gnas pa'i dman pa'i gang zag de/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na spyir 'bras gnas bzhi char la dad mos dang*/ mthong thob gnyis gnyis yod do// bye brag tu dbang brtul du gyur pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas de/ dad mos pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbang rnon du gyur pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas de/ rgyun zhugs mthong thob pa'i mtshan nyid/ zhes sogs rigs bsgres nas shes par bya'o// rgyun zhugs la tsam khyad kyi sgo nas dbye na/ tsam po dang khyad par can gnyis/ 'bras bu phyi ma thob phyir du mi brtson pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ der brtson pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas de/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas khyad par can gyi mtshan nyid/ dang po ni/ bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa la gnas bzhin pa'i rgyun zhugs lta bu la bya/ gnyis pa ni/ sgom spangs su gyur pa'i nyon mongs dang po sogs spong ba la brtson bzhin pa'i rgyun zhugs lta bu la bya'o// skye ba len tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ rgyun zhugs srid pa lan bdun pa dang*/ rgyun zhugs rigs nas rigs skye gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ bye brag tu smra ba ltar na/ 'dod par skye ba nyi shu rtsa brgyad len par 'gyur ba'i rigs can gyi rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po de/ srid pa lan bdun pa'i rgyun zhugs kyi mtshan nyid/ mngon pa gong ma ba yang bye brag tu smra ba dang mthun no// de la dbye na/ myong bar nges pa'i srid pa lan bdun pa dang*/ myong bar ma nges pa'i srid pa lan bdun pa gnyis so// srid pa lan bdun pa'i rigs can gang zhig 'dod par skye ba nyi shu rtsa brgyad len par nges pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ der ma nges pa'i srid pa lan bdun pa de/

gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dir myong bar nges pa'i srid pa lan bdun pa dang*/ re ltar thogs nas lan bdun pa zhes pa ni don gcig ming gi rnams grangs so// gnyis pa la/ 'dod pa'i sgom spangs su gyur pa'i nyon mongs gsum pa spangs shing*/ lnga pa ma spangs par gyur pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas gang zhig 'dod par rigs mthun gyi srid pa gnyis len pa'i rigs can de/ rigs nas rigs su skye ba'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ lha'i rigs nas rigs skye dang*/ mi'i rigs nas rigs skyes gnyis/ rigs nas rigs su skye ba'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas gang zhig 'dod pa'i lhar srid pa lan gnyis len pa'i rigs can de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig mi'i rten la srid pa lan gnyis len pa'i rigs can de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'di dag la'ang*/ myong bar nges pa'i rigs nas rigs skye dang*/ myong bar ma nges pa'i rigs nas rigs skye gnyis gnyis su rigs pas thob bo// gsum pa phyir 'ong zhugs pa la/ 'dod nyon drug pa spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson bzhin pa'i dman pa'i gang zag gang zhig lam rjes shes kyi rtogs pa thob pa de/ chags bral sngon du ma song ba'i phyir 'ong zhugs pa'am/ 'bras bu rim gyis pa'i phyir 'ong zhugs pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na dad mos pa dang*/ mthong thob pa gnyis/ bzhi pa phyir 'ong 'bras gnas la/ 'dod pa'i sgom spangs su gyur pa'i nyon mongs drug pa tsam spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu la gnas pa'i spangs bya rim gyis pa'i rgyu lnga tshang ba'i slob pa 'bras gnas gang zhig 'dod nyon drug pa mthong lam gyi rjes thogs su spangs pa de/ 'bras bu rim gyis pa'i phyir 'ong 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ tsam po dang*/ tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa gnyis/ 'bras bu phyi ma thob phyir du mi brtson pa'i 'bras gnas de dang po'i mtshan nyid/

'dod nyon bdun pa spangs shing*/ 'dod par rigs mthun gyi skye ba gcig kho na len par nges pa'i phyir 'ong de/ phyir 'ong tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa'i mtshan nyid/ lnga pa phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa la/ tha ma'i cha mthun lnga spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson bzhin pa'i dman pa'i gang zag gang zhig bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob pa de/ 'bras bu rim gyis pa'i phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ dad mos pa dang*/ mthong thob pa gnyis/ drug pa 'bras bu rim gyis pa'i phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas la mtshan nyid ni/ tha ma'i cha mthun lnga spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu la gnas pa'i rgyu lnga tshang ba'i slob pa 'bras gnas gang zhig 'dod nyon dgu pa mthong lam gyi rjes thogs su spangs pa'o// de la tsam khyad kyi sgo nas dbye na/ tsam po dang*/ khyad par can gnyis te/ rtogs par sla'o// ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ mthong chos zhi/ lus mngon byed/ tshe yongs su 'gyur ba'i 'phags pa/ khams gong mar nyer 'gro dang bzhi'o// dang po la/ tshe 'di nyid la dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu mngon du byed par nges pa'i gang zag de/ spyir mthong chos zhi tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni rgyun zhugs dang*/ phyir 'ong dang*/ phyir mi 'ong gsum char la yod do// de ltar nges pa'i phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas de/ phyir mi 'ong du gyur pa'i mthong chos zhi'i mtshan nyid/ rnam par mthar pa brgyad thob la ma nyams pa'i phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas de/ phyir mi 'ong du gyur pa'i lus mngon byed kyi mtshan nyid/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas gang zhig 'phags pa thob rjes su khams gsum gang rung du skye ba brgyud mar len myong ba de/ phyir mi 'ong yin pa'i tshe yongs su 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ 'dod par tshe yongs 'gyur gyi phyir mi 'ong dang*/ khams gong mar yongs 'gyur gyi phyir mi 'ong gnyis/

dang po yin na khams gzhan du mi 'gro bas khyab ste/ 'dod par tshe yongs gyur pa'i 'phags khams gzhan du ni 'gro ba med// ces so// gnyis pa la des ma khyab pa yin te/ gzugs su tshe yongs su 'gyur ba'i 'phags pa gzugs med du skye ba len pa yod pa'i phyir ro// spyir 'phags pa thob rjes su khams gsum gang rung du skye ba brgyud mar len myong ba'i gang zag de/ spyir tshe yongs 'gyur gyi 'phags pa tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni 'bras gnas bzhi char la yod do// 'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong gang zhig khams gong mar 'phen byed kyi las dang ldan pa de khams gong mar nyer 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong gi mtshan nyid/ spyir khams gong mar nye 'gro tsam ni rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong gnyis la'ang srid do// dbye na gzugs su nye 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong dang*/ gzugs med nye 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong gnyis/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong gang zhig gzugs khams su skye ba 'phen byed kyi las dang ldan pa de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ bar dor 'da' ba/ skye 'da' ba/ gong 'pho dang gsum/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas gang zhig gzugs su skye ba'i kun sbyor spangs shing*/ gzugs su mngon par 'grub pa'i kun sbyor gyi las dang ldan pa de/ phyir mi 'ong bar 'da' ba'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ myur bar 'da' ba/ myur ba ma yin par 'da' ba/ dus ring mo zhig nas 'da' ba dang gsum/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong gang zhig gzugs khams su skye ba gcig kho na blangs nas/ gzugs khams kyi rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i rigs can de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ skyes ma thag 'da' ba/ mngon par 'du byed dang bcas te 'da' ba/ mngon par 'du byed med par 'da' dang gsum/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong gang zhig gzugs khams su lan grangs gzhan la myong gyur gyi las dang ldan pa de/

phyir mi 'ong gong 'pho'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ 'og min gyi mthar thug 'gro dang*/ srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro gnyis/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong gang zhig bsam gtan bzhi pa'i spel sgom thob pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ 'phar ba/ phyed du 'phar ba/ gnas thams cad du 'chi 'pho ba dang gsum/ phyir mi 'ong 'og min gyi mthar thug 'gro gang zhig gzugs khams su skye ba gnyis blangs nas/ 'og min gyi rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i rigs can de/ phyir mi 'ong 'phar ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'dir gzugs khams su skye srid gnyis len mi dgos te/ tshangs rigs su skye srid gcig blangs nas/ 'ong min gyi bar rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i 'phar ba yod pa'i phyir/ yang de gang zhig gzugs khams kyi rten la skye ba gsum blangs nas 'og min gyi rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i rigs can de/ phyir mi 'ong phyed 'phar gyi mtshan nyid/ yang de gang zhig gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun du rim gyis skyes nas/ mthar 'og min gyi rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa de/ phyir mi 'ong gnas thams cad 'chi 'pho'i mtshan nyid/ 'di dag la myong bar nges ma nges gnyis gnyis su dbyer yod de/ ji skad du mdzod 'grel las/ gong du 'pho ba bar skabs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ltar rung ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa mchog tu thogs na srid pa lan bdun pa bzhin no// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro// gzugs su nyer 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong gong 'pho gang zhig bsam gtan gyi spel ma ma sgom par zhi gnas 'ba' zhig gtso bor sgom pas/ gzugs med kyi rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa de/ phyir mi 'ong gzugs su nyer 'gro'i srid rtse'i mtha' thug 'gro ba'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa phyir mi 'ong gzugs med nyer 'gro'i mtshan nyid ni/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas gang zhig

gzugs la 'dod chags bral zhing gzugs med du skye ba'i las dang ldan pa'o// dbye na gzugs med nyer 'gro'i skye 'da' ba dang*/ de'i gong 'pho gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ gzugs med nyer 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong gang zhig gzugs med du skye ba gcig kho na blangs nas myang 'das mngon du byed pa'o// gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ de gang zhig gzugs med khams su lan grangs gzhan la myong gyur gyi las dang ldan pa'o// bdun pa dgra bcom zhugs pa la/ khams gsum gyi sgom spangs ma lus par spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu thob phyir du brtson bzhin pa'i phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas de/ spang bya rim gyis pa'i dgra bcom zhugs pa'i mtshan nyid/ yang des rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu la gnas pa'i spangs bya rim gyis pa de/ spang bya rim gyis pa'i dgra bcom 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ de la mdor bsdus te brjod na/ dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu la gnas pa'i dman pa'i gang zag de/ theg dman 'bras gnas tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas la sogs pa bzhi'o// 'dod nyon drug pa mthong lam gyi snga rol tu ma spangs shing*/ mthong spangs tsam spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dman pa'i 'bras gnas de/ rgyun zhugs 'bras kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dod nyon drug pa spangs shing dgu pa ma spangs pa'i spang bya rim gyis pa'i rgyu lnga tshang ba'i dman pa'i 'bras gnas de/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs pa'i rgyu lnga tshang ba'i dman pa'i slob pa 'bras gnas de/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ nyon mongs ma lus par spangs pa'i rgyu lnga tshang ba'i dman pa'i 'bras gnas de/ dgra bcom 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ de la rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ yongs su nyams pa'i chos can gyi dang*/ bdag gsod pa'i chos can gyi dang*/ rjes su bsrung ba'i chos can gyi dang*/

gnas pa las mi bskyod pa'i chos can gyi dang*/ rtogs pa'i skal ba can gyi dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyi dang drug go /spyir rigs drug po 'di so so skye bo dang*/ slob pa 'phags pa'i gnas skabs na yod pa yin te/ ji skad du/ slob dang 'phags min rigs drug ldan// zhes so// de la bye brag tu smra ba ltar na/ yongs su nyams pa'i chos can gyi dgra bcom ni/ phal cher dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu las nyams pa'i rigs can cig yin/ gnyis pa ni/ sku tshe'i 'du byed ma btang na dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu dang*/ rang gi rigs las phal cher nyams la/ sku tshe'i 'du byed btang na mi nyams pa'i rigs can yin no// gsum pa ni/ 'dod nyon la sems bsrung na dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu dang*/ rang gi rigs las phal cher mi nyams shing*/ ma bsrung na phal cher nyams pa cig go /bzhi pa ni/ phal cher de dag las mi nyams shing dbang po rnon por 'pho mi nus pa'i rigs can cig go /lnga pa ni/ de las mi nyams shing phal cher dbang po rnon por 'pho nus pa'i rigs can yin/ drug pa ni/ de las nyams pa mi srid cing*/ dbang po 'pho mi dgos pa zhig yin/ de lta na yang yongs su nyams pa'i chos can gyi rgyun zhugs ni/ rang gi 'bras bu las nyams pa mi srid pa'i phyir 'dod do// mdo sde pa ltar na/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu las nyams pa mi srid la/ mdo las nyams pa'i chos can sogs gsung pa de ni/ mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin las nyams pa srid pa la dgongs par 'dod do// drug po de dag bsdu na gnyis su 'du ste/ dang po lnga po de/ dbang po brtul po yin zhing*/ dus sbyor ba zhes bya/ tha ma ni dbang po rnon po yin zhing dus mi sbyor zhes bya/ dgra bcom la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rkyang ba'i cha las rnam par grol ba gnyis/ dgra bcom 'bras gnas gang zhig

mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu thob pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dgra bcom 'bras gnas gang zhig de ma thob pa de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba'o// byang sems kyi dge 'dun de mtshan nyid do// dbye na/ nyan thos kyi ming can dang*/ rang rgyal gyi ming can no// dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ zhugs gnas kyi gang zag brgyad po gang rung gi ming gis 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i byang sems/ dbye na rgyun zhugs kyi skor la lnga/ phyir 'ong gi skor la gsum/ phyir mi 'ong gi skor la bcu/ dgra bcom zhugs pa'i ming can no// dang po la/ rgyun zhugs pa'i ming gis 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i byang sems de/ de'i ming can gyi byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni mthong lam skad cig dang po bco lnga gang rung gi rtogs pa la gnas pa'i byang sems lta bu la zer/ chos gsum ni/ 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ btags pa'i dgos pa/ dngos la gnod byed gsum/ dang po ni/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa dang*/ spangs rtogs gnyis kyi cha 'ga' zhig 'dra'o// btags pa'i dgos pa ni/ de la dge 'dun dkon mchog tu yid ches par bya ba'i phyir ram/ nyan thos kyi rigs can theg pa chen po la rim gyis zhugs pa'o// dngos la gnod byed ni/ rgyun zhugs sogs dngos yin na/ theg pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag 'chol bar 'gyur ro// de la dbye na/ dad pa'i rjes 'brang gi ming can dang*/ chos kyi rjes 'brang gi ming can gnyis/ bcu drug po'i rtogs pa thob ma myong ba'i dbang brtul de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de thob myong ba'i dbang rnon de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas kyi ming gis 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i byang sems de/ de'i ming can gyi byang sems kyi dge 'dun gyi mtshan nyid/ dang po 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan la/ de chos can/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas dang spangs pa cha 'dra ba yin te/

mthong spangs spangs par 'dra ba'i phyir/ rtogs pa cha 'dra ba yin te/ de spong bar byed pa'i bar chad med lam dang*/ de spangs pa'i rnam grol lam thob par cha 'dra ba'i phyir/ dngos la gnod byed ni rgyun zhugs dngos min te/ byang sems yin pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na/ lha'i rigs nas rigs skye'i ming can dang*/ mi'i rigs nas rigs skye'i ming can gyi byang sems gnyis la/ lha'i rigs nas rigs skye'i ming gis 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni 'dod pa'i lha rigs mthun gyi skye srid gnyis sam/ gsum blangs nas/ sangs rgyas tshul ston pa'i sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang sems la bya/ rgyun zhugs mi'i rigs nas rigs skye'i ming gis 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni mi'i rten la skye ba gnyis sam/ gsum blangs nas sangs rgya tshul ston pa'i byang sems sa dang po lta bu la bya/ byang sems 'di dag gis 'dod pa la chags bral ma mdzad pa ni min te/ mdo las/ 'di'i skabs kyi byang sems des/ bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gzugs med bzhi la ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin snyoms par 'jug par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang 'dod pa'i nyon mongs kyi bag la nyal gsum pa spangs pa dang*/ de'i gnyen po zag med kyi dbang po thob pa dang*/ 'dod par skye ba gnyis sam gsum len pa ste/ khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa'i byang sems cig la/ rgyun zhugs rigs nas rigs skye'i ming gis 'dogs par nyi snang las bshad do// gnyis pa phyir 'ong gi skor gsum la/ phyir 'ong zhugs pa'i ming gis 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i byang sems de/ de'i ming can gyi byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni 'dod pa'i khams su lan gcig skye ba blangs nas/ sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa'i spyod pa la zhugs pa'i byang sems 'dod nyon drug pa'i bag la nyal ma spangs pa lta bu la bya'o// 'di la dbye na/

dad mos kyi ming can dang*/ mthong thob kyi ming can gnyis yod kyang*/ gcig kho nar bgrang ngo*// phyir 'ong 'bras gnas kyi ming gis 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i byang sems de/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas kyi ming can gyi byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni 'dod nyon drug pa'i bag la nyal spangs pa'i spyod pa la zhugs pa'i byang sems 'dod pa khams su lan cig 'ong nas sangs rgya tshul ston pa'i byang sems lta bu la bya/ phyir 'ong tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa'i ming gi 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i byang sems de/ de'i ming can gyi byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs bdun pa'i bag chags spangs shing*/ 'dod par skye ba gcig kho na blangs nas sangs rgya tshul ston pa'i spyod pa la zhugs pa'i byang sems lta bu la bya'o// 'di mdo las skye ba gcig gi thogs par bshad kyang*/ skye ba gcig blangs nas sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa la dgongs pa can yin gyi/ sa bcu par 'chad pa skabs kyi don ma yin no// gsum pa phyir mi 'ong gi skor la/ zhugs pa'i ming can dang*/ 'bras gnas kyi ming can gnyis/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa'i ming gi 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i byang sems de/ de'i ming can gyi byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni 'dod nyon dgu pa'i bag la nyal ma spangs shing*/ 'dod pa'i khams su skye ba mi len par zhing sna tshogs su sangs rgya tshul ston pa'i spyod pa la zhugs pa'i byang sems lta bu la bya/ 'di la dbye na/ dad thob gnyis yod kyang gcig tu bgrang ngo*// gnyis pa la phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas kyi ming gis 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i byang sems de/ de'i ming can gyi byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni 'dod nyon dgu pa'i bag la nyal spangs pa'i phyir mi ldog gi byang sems 'dod pa khams su skye ba mi len par/ sangs rgya tshul ston pa lta bu la bya/ de la dbye na dgu las/

phyir mi 'ong bar 'da' ba'i ming gis 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i byang sems de/ de'i ming can gyi byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu drug gang rung gi rten la/ sangs rgya tshul ston pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems lta bu la bya/ bar do'i rten la sangs rgya tshul ston par mdo las ma gsung kyang sbyar na rung tsam mo// phyir mi 'ong skye 'da' ba'i ming gi 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba de/ de'i ming can gyi byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni gzugs khams su skye ba gcig kho na blangs nas sangs rgya tshul ston pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems lta bu'o// phyir mi 'ong byed bcas kyi ming 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i byang sems de/ de'i ming can gyi byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni gzugs khams su skye ba gcig kho na len pa'i tshul ston cing*/ sems can gyi don la brtson pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems lta bu'o// phyir mi 'ong byed med kyi ming gi 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i byang sems de/ de'i ming can gyi byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni sems can gyi don la mi brtson pa'i byang sems snga ma lta bu la bya'o// phyir mi 'ong gi 'og min gyi mthar thug 'gro'i ming gi 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i byang sems de/ de'i ming can gyi byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na gsum las/ mtshan nyid ni rigs bsgre/ 'phar ba'i ming can gyi mtshan gzhi ni/ bsam gtan gong ma las nyams pa'i tshul bstan nas/ phyi ma tshang rigs su skye zhing*/ de nas 'og min du skyes nas rten de la sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems lta bu'o// phyed du 'phar ba'i mtshan gzhi ni/ tshangs rigs nas gnas gtsang ma'i 'og ma gsum po gang rung cig tu skyes nas/ bar gyi gnas rnams rgal te/ 'og min gyi rten la sangs rgya tshul ston pa'i byang sems lta bu'o// gnas thams cad du 'chi 'pho ba'i ming can gyi mtshan gzhi ni/

dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i byang sems tshangs rigs nas 'og min gyi bar du skyes te/ zhing sna tshogs su sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa la bya'o// srid rtsi'i mthar thug 'gro ba'i ming gi 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i byang sems de/ de'i ming can gyi byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni dper na rnam par thar pa brgyad thob pa'i byang sems tshangs rigs nas dge rgyas kyi bar du song zhing*/ gnas gtsang du mi skye bar gzugs med bzhir rim gyis skyes te/ zhing sna tshogs su sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa'i byang sems de nyid la gzugs kyi chags bcom zhes kyang bya ste/ gzugs med kyi snyoms par 'jug pa thob pa'i phyir/ brgyad pa mthong chos zhi'i ming can gyi mtshan nyid 'dre zhing*/ mtshan nyid ni/ byang sems chen po gang zhig mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan zhing sems can gang gis mthong ba'i sems can de/ myang 'das la 'god nus pa cig la bya'o// dgu pa lus mngon byed ni/ mthar gnas kyi snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du snyoms par 'jug nus pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems cig la bya'o// dgra bcom zhugs pa'i ming gi 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i byang sems de/ de'i ming can gyi byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni sa bcu pa la gnas pa'i byang sems lta bu la bya'o// gnyis pa rang rgyal gyi ming gis 'dogs pa'i chos gsum tshang ba'i byang sems de/ de'i ming can gyi byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/ dper na sangs rgyas dang nyan thos gnyis ka med pa'i zhing 'ga' zhig tu sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa'i byang sems lta bu la bya'o// de ltar nyi shu'o// bshad ma thag pa'i byang sems nyi shu po 'di dag ni/ zhugs gnas brgyad dang*/ rang rgyal btags pa ba yin kyang*/ rtsa bar dngos su bstan pa'i dbang po brtul po nas bse ru lta bu'i bar ni/ btags pa ba min te/ de dag dngos yin pa la gnod byed med cing*/

gzhung 'grel las kyang mtshan nyid par bshad pa'i phyir/ des na mtshan gzhi de dag ngos bzung nas/ rgyun zhugs su gyur pa'i rigs skye btags pa ba yin zhing*/ rigs nas rigs skye mtshan nyid pa yin/ zhes sogs sbyar bar bya'o// mtshan gzhi 'di dag kyang mdo dang nyi snang gi don la rnam par btags pa yin pas khung btsun par byos shig ༈ /bzhi pa mi mthun phyogs sel byed brtson 'grus gsum la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag la/ gdams ngag dngos kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ yul brtson 'grus gsum gyi mtshan nyid bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i tshe/ bya ba ngan zhen dang*/ sgyid lug pa dang*/ bdag nyid la brnyas pa'i le lo de gsum gyi gnyen por/ brtson 'grus gsum don dam par mi dmigs shing*/ tha snyad du nyams su longs shigs ces 'doms pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung de 'dir bstan gyi brtson 'grus gsum la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa la/ lus ngag gi spyod pa rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i sgo nas de la ma chags pa'i dge ba la spro ba'i sems byung de/ ma zhen pa'i brtson 'grus kyi mtshan nyid/ sgyid lug pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i dge ba la spro ba'i sems byung de/ mi ngal ba'i brtson 'grus kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag nyid la brnyas shing zhum pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i dge ba la spro ba'i sems byung de/ lam yongs su 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus kyi mtshan nyid/ lnga pa spyan dang mngon shes la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag la/ dngos dang*/ yul spyan dang mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i tshe/ 'bras bu spyan dang mngon shes la mngon par zhen pa med par sgrub pa nyams su long cig ces 'doms pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung de/ 'dir bstan gyi de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa la spyan bshad pa dang*/ mngon shes bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o// dang po ni/

thun mong ba'i bdag rkyen pha rol tu phyin pa drug gam/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la brten cing*/ rang gi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen la brten nas rang yul mngon sum du mthong ba'i rig pa de/ 'dir bstan spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na lnga las/ thun mong gi bdag rkyen rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dang*/ thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi skyon sbyang pa'i sha'i mig dbang gzugs can la brten nas dpag tshad brgya nas stong gsum gyi bar gang rung mthong ba'i yul can de sha'i spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ thun mong ba'i bdag rkyen rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen las kyi rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i lha'i mig dbang gzugs can pa la brten nas/ sems can thams cad kyi 'chi 'pho ba dang*/ skye ba mthong ba'i yul can gyi rig pa de/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i lha'i spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ thun mong gi bdag rkyen rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen lhag mthong khyad par can la brten nas/ chos thams cad la cir yang mi rtog pa'i rig pa de/ shes rab kyi spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ thun mong gi de dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen lhag mthong khyad par can la brten nas rang dang rgyu tshod mnyam pa man chod kyi 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i yul can gyi rig pa de chos kyi spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ thun mong gi dang thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen lhag mthong khyad par can la brten nas/ chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i yul can gyi rig pa de/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams la/ dang po ni/ tshogs lam/ gnyis pa ni sbyor lam/ gsum pa ni byang sems 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag bzhi pa ni byang sems 'phags pa'i rjes thob/ lnga pa mtshan nyid pa sangs rgyas kyi sa na yod cing*/ rjes mthun pa sa bdun pa yang yod do// gnyis pa mngon shes la/

rang gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas rang yul mngon sum du mthong ba'i rig pa de mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na drug las/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas sa g.yo ba la sogs par byed nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel de/ rdzu 'phrul gyi de'i mtshan nyid/ yang de la brten nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na gnas pa'i sgra chung ngu dang ci shos thos par nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin de/ lha'i rna ba'i de'i mtshan nyid/ de la brten nas/ gzhan gyi sems 'dod chags yod med sogs shes par byed nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de/ gzhan sems shes pa'i de'i mtshan nyid/ de la brten nas/ rang gzhan gyi tshe rabs dpag tu med pa rjes su dran par byed nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i de'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas/ sems can thams cad 'chi 'pho ba dang*/ skye ba dang*/ de dag gi kha dog sna tshogs pa rnams mngon sum du mthong bar nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de/ tshe 'dir bsam gtan sgom pa las byung ba'i lha'i mig gi mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ 'di dang lha'i spyan gnyis la khyad par ci yod ce na/ snga ma ni sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa las byung ba yin la/ phyi ma ni tshe 'dir bsam gtan sgom pa las byung ba ni 'di'i khyad par yin par nyi snang las bshad/ 'bum phrag gsum pa de'i steng du spyan dang mngon shes kyi sde tshan mi gcig pa dang*/ snga mas 'chi 'pho dang*/ skye ba mthong ba dang*/ phyi mas gzugs thams cad mthong bas yul gyi khyad par dang*/ khyad par gsum ldan du 'chad kyang mi 'thad de/ phyi mas kyang 'chi 'pho dang*/ skye ba mthong bar mdo nyid las bshad pa'i phyir ro// sde tshan mi gcig pa ni rtsod gzhi yin pa'i phyir ro// rang gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan sa drug po gang rung la brten nas/

sgrib gnyis gang rung gi sa bon spangs pa'i rnam grol lam/ spong bar byed bzhin ba'i bar chad med lam gyi ngo bor skyes pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel de/ zag pa zad pa shes pa'i mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ skabs 'dir drug po gang rung yin na dge ba yin pas khyab ste/ mngon pa gong ma las ngo bo ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab tu bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ mngon pa 'og ma las/ mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes ni// lung du ma bstan lhag rnams dge /zhes bya'o// mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes kyi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen ni dbang po gzugs can pa yin la/ lhag ma bzhi ni thun mong gi bdag rkyen yid la brten pa yin no// sa mtshams la mngon shes dang po lnga ni phyi rol pa dang thun mong ba yin la/ drug pa ni 'phags pa thams cad la yod do// 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i spyan dang mngon par shes pa 'di dag ni byang sems dang sangs rgyas kyi dbang du byas par yin par mdo las bshad do// drug pa sgrub pa mthar thug pa'i rgyu mthong sgom gnyis la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag la/ mthong sgom gyi lam don dam par mi dmigs shing*/ kun rdzob tu sgrib pa'i gnyen por nyams su long zhig ces 'doms pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung de/ 'dir bstan gyi mthong sgom gyi lam la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sngar bshad pa'i gdams ngag bcu'i mtshan nyid rnams so sor 'phral nas shes par bya'o// gnyis pa bstan bya sgrub pa nyid bshad pa la/ sgrub pa'i dang po nges 'byed yan lag bshad pa dang*/ sgrub pa khyad par du 'phel ba'i rim pa bshad pa'o// dang po la/ rang rgyu theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun rdzogs rjes su byung zhing*/ chos nyid la don spyi'i tshul gyis sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i theg chen so skye'i mngon rtogs sam/ 'dir bstan gyi khyad chos lnga dang ldan pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de/ 'dir bstan gyi theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag gi mtshan nyid/

khyad chos lnga ni/ theg chen sbyor lam dang thun mong min pa'i dmigs pa la dmigs pa de dang*/ thun mong min pa'i rnam pas sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang*/ de dang thun mong min pa'i rtogs rigs kyi rgyu byed pa dang*/ de dang thun mong min pa'i spang bya spong ba dang*/ de dang thun mong min pa'i yongs 'dzin dang ldan pa'o// theg chen sbyor lam gyi sgro 'dog bcad pa'i gzhir bzung zhing*/ theg chen sbyor lam gyi sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i gzhir ma bzung ba de/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam gyi thun mong min pa'i dmigs pa'i khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni mi rtag la sogs bcu drug lta bu dang*/ gzugs sogs ngo bo nyid med pa lta bu'o// sbyor lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sgo nas chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de/ theg chen sbyor lam gyi thun mong min pa'i rnam pa'i khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi mngon zhen med pa'i rnam pa can gyi ye shes lta bu'o// rang 'bras theg pa gsum char gyi rtogs rigs tshang bar thob pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam rang stobs kyi 'dren nus pa de/ theg chen sbyor lam gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu'i khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi bdag med gnyis ka rtogs pa'i ye shes lta bu la bya'o// theg chen sbyor lam pa theg dman du mi ltung bar theg chen du yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de/ theg chen sbyor lam pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i yongs 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam dang 'dzin stangs mi 'gal ba'i 'dir bstan gyi rtog pa bzhi spong bar nus pa'i theg chen sbyor lam gyi nus pa de/ theg chen sbyor lam gyi thun mong min pa'i rnam rtog ldan tshul gyi khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen sbyor lam la dbye na/ drod/ rtse mo/

bzod pa/ chos mchog dang bzhi/ mtshan nyid ni rim pa ltar 'grel chen ltar na/ rang rgyu theg gyi thar pa cha mthun rdzogs rjes su kun nas nyon mongs kyi bzung ba rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang mched pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ drod kyi ye shes rdzogs rjes su byung zhing*/ rnam byang gi bzung ba rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang gtso bor mched pa'i zhig lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ rtse mo'i ye shes rdzogs rjes su/ gang zag rdzas yod kyi 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang gtso bor mched pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa dang*/ bzod pa rdzogs rjes su/ skyes bu btags yod kyi 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang gtso bor mched pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa'o// rtsa ba dang*/ 'grel pa don gsal 'di ltar na/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyi khyad par dang ldan pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de 'dir bstan gyi drod kyi mtshan nyid yin pa nas/ ting 'dzin de'i byed pa nyid// zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyi khyad par dang ldan pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de/ 'dir bstan gyi chos mchog gi mtshan nyid/ zhes sbyar na legs so bye brag tu spang bya rtog pa'i rnam par gzhag pa la/ yul gyi gnas tshul la phyin ci log tu zhugs pa'i blo gang zhig gtso bor thams cad mkhyen pa la bar du gcod byed de/ 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la yul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ gzung rtog dang*/ 'dzin rtog gnyis/ 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa gang zhig yul bzung ba la dmigs nas bzung bar zhen pa'i blo de/ 'dir bstan bzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na kun nas nyon mongs bzung rtog dang*/ rnam byang bzung rtog gnyis/ 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa gang zhig

kun nas nyon mongs kyi phyogs la dmigs nas bzung bar zhen pa'i blo de/ 'dir bstan kun nas nyon mongs bzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ de la yul gyi sgo nas dbye na dgu/ 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa gang zhig rnam byang gi phyogs la dmigs nas bzung bar zhen pa'i blo de/ 'dir bstan gyi rnam byang bzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ de la yul gyi sgo nas dbye na dgu/ 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa gang zhig yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de/ 'dir bstan 'dzin rtog gi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ 'dir bstan rtog pa gang zhig gang zag gi gdags gzhir gyur pa'i 'dzin pa la dmigs nas rdzas yod du zhen pa'i blo de/ 'dir bstan rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la yul gyi sgo nas dbye na dgu/ 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa gang zhig skyes bu'i gdags gzhir gyur pa'i 'dzin pa la dmigs nas btags pa tsam du zhen pa'i blo de/ 'dir bstan btags 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la yul gyi sgo nas dbye na dgu/ de ltar rtog pa sum cu so drug po de la/ khams gsum gyi dbye bas brgya rtsa brgyad du yang 'gyur ro// 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa la spong byed gnyen po'i sgo nas dbye na/ mthong spangs su gyur pa'i rtog pa dang*/ sgom spangs su gyur pa'i rtog pa gnyis/ 'dir bstan gyi spangs bya rtog pa gang zhig grub mtha'i dbang gis sgro btags pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'dir bstan gyi spang bya rtog pa gang zhig grub mtha' ngan pas sgro btags pa la ma ltos par lhan skyes su 'byung ba de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dir bstan gyi rtog pa lhan skyes yin na/ grub mtha' la ma zhugs pa kho na'i rgyud la 'byung bas ma khyab ste/ grub mtha' la ma zhugs pa'i gang zag gi rgyud la btags 'dzin rtog pa lhan skyes mi 'byung ba'i phyir/

gnyis po re re la yang bzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog gnyis gnyis su phye ba nas bzung ste/ brgya rtsa brgyad du dbye ba'i bar snga ma kho na bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub pa khyad par du 'phel ba'i rim pa bshad pa la/ sgrub pa'i yan lag bshad pa dang*/ yan lag can sgrub pa'i dbye ba bshad pa'o// dang po la/ sgrub pa'i rten dang*/ dmigs pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bstan bya'i gtso bo bshad pa dang*/ de las 'phros pa'i don bshad pa'o// dang po la/ rang gi rten chos theg chen sgrub pa'i rten gzhir gyur pa de/ theg chen sgrub pa'i rten gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gnas skabs kyi rten dang*/ mthar thug gi rten gnyis/ gnas skabs kyi rten ni sgrub pa po byang sems nyid la bya/ mthar thug gi rten ni byang sems de'i rgyud kyi sems rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa la bya'o// sems kyi rang bzhin rnam dag de la ngo bo gcig cing*/ ldog pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba dang*/ sems kyi chos dbyings rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur la/ de gnyis dbyer med pa la rang bzhin gnas rigs zhes bya zhing*/ 'bras bu'i gnas skabs su zag pa med pa'i ye shes dang*/ chos nyid dbyer med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi de la sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi sku zhes bya'o// 'di la rten gyi sgo nas dbye na/ rten chos sgrub pa bcu gsum gyi dbye bas bcu gsum mo// bcu gsum ni/ rtogs pa'i chos drug gi sgrub pa drug gnyen po'i sgrub pa/ spong ba'i sgrub pa/ de dag yongs su gtugs pa'i sgrub pa/ shes rab snying brtser bcas pa'i sgrub pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub pa/ gzhan don go rim du byed pa'i sgrub pa/ ye shes brtsol ba mi mnga' bar 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang bcu gsum yin la/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzhi dang*/ mthong lam dang*/ sa bdun pa man chad kyi sgom lam rnams la rtogs pa'i chos drug gi sgrub pa zhes bya/

sa brgyad pa'i bar chad med lam la gnyen po'i sgrub pa zhes bya/ sa brgyad pa'i nyon sgrib spangs pa'i rnam grol lam la spong ba'i sgrub pa zhes bya/ 'dir spangs pa dang spong ba don gcig pa yin te/ dper na spong ba chen po bzhin no// sa brgyad pa'i shes sgrib spangs pa'i rnam grol lam la de dag yongs su gtugs pa'i bsgrub pa zhes bya/ sa dgu pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes la shes rab snying brtser bcas pa'i sgrub pa zhes bya/ sa dgu pa'i khyad par gyi lam la thun mong min pa'i sgrub pa zhes bya/ sa bcu pa'i ye shes la gzhan don go rim du byed pa'i sgrub pa zhes bya/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes la ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar 'jug pa'i sgrub pa zhes bya/ de ltar na/ rang gi rten chos theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod kyi rten gzhir gyur pa'i sems kyi rang bzhin rnam dag de/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam gyi drod kyi sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid yin pa nas/ rang gi rten chos rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi rten gzhir gyur pa'i sems kyi rang bzhin rnam dag de/ ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid kyi bar du sbyar te shes par bya'o// gnyis pa de la 'phros nas rigs kyi rnam pa bzhag pa la/ bye brag tu smra bas sems byung ma chags pa'i rang bzhin 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa de/ rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gnas mal dang*/ chos gos dang*/ bsod snyoms ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa dang gsum/ spong ba dang sgom pa la mngon par dga' ba ste/ 'phags pa'i rigs bzhir 'dod do// mdo sde pas zag pa med pa'i sems kyi sa bon byang chub 'byung rung gi nus pa de la rigs kyi mtshan nyid du 'dod do// sems tsam pa la lugs gnyis las/ phyogs kyi glang pos/ sems byung brtse ba dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin la rigs su 'dod do// thogs med sku mched kyi lugs la/

rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis/ dang po ni/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'am/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i steng gi rang 'bras byang chub 'byung rung gi nus pa/ thog ma med pa'i dus can cig la 'dod do// 'di la ming gi rnam grangs ni skye mched drug gi khyad par/ thos pa'i bag chags/ zag pa med pa'i sa bon zhes bya/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs ni/ gsar du yang dag par blangs pa las byung ba'i byang chub thob rung gi nus pa'o// mdor na grub mtha' smra ba de gsum gyis/ rigs la dngos pos khyab par 'dod do// mdor na sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs de nyid/ rkyen gyi nus pas bltas par byas pa na rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs zhes bya ba yin te/ rgya mtsho sprin las/ rigs de nyid gnas skabs kyi khyad par gzhan du gyur pa las ming gzhan gyi bstan pa ni/ yang dag par sgrub par zhes bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// mdor na rigs chad pa'i sems can dang*/ ma chad pa'i sems can gnyis/ rigs ma chad pa la rigs nges pa dang*/ ma nges pa gnyis/ nges pa la nyan thos su rigs nges pa/ rang rgyal du rigs nges pa/ sangs rgyas su rigs nges pa dang gsum du sems tsam pa bzhed do// sems tsam pas chos dbyings rigs btags pa bar bzhed pa'i skabs kyang yod do// mngon pa kun las btus las ci'i phyir chos kyi dbyings zhes bya zhes na/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi rgyu yi phyir/ zhes pa dang*/ dbus mtha' las kyang de bzhin du bshad do// dbu ma'i lugs la rigs bshad pa dang*/ zhar la bde gshegs snying po ngos bzung ba gnyis/ gnas gyur pa na byang chub tu 'gyur du rung ba de/ spyir rigs tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba dang*/ rten chos kyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis so// dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi rang bzhin gang zhig

blo bur gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa na sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi skur 'gyur du rung ba de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la ldog pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings dang*/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba gnyis/ dang po/ blo bur gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor nyid skur 'gyur rung yin phyir/ chos nyid rang bzhin gnas rigs zhes bya/ phyi ma yang sems kyi rang bzhin yin pa gang zhig gnas gyur pa na ye shes kyi skur 'gyur rung yin phyir/ chos can rang bzhin rigs zhes bya/ gsar du yang dag par sgrub pa'i dge rtsa gang zhig sangs rgyas kyi kun rdzob pa'i skur 'gyur rung ste/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis la byed do// gnyis pa rten chos kyi sgo nas dbye na/ nyan thos kyi rigs/ rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rigs dang gsum/ de re re la yang rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis gnyis su dbyer yod la/ nyan thos kyi rigs can gyi sems kyi chos dbyings de la nyan thos kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs zhes bya ste/ nyan thos kyi sems kyi rang bzhin gang zhig gnas gyur pa na nyan thos kyi lhag med myang 'das su 'gyur du rung ba'i phyir ro// de bzhin du gzhan la yang sbyar bar bya'o// zhar la bde gshegs snying po ngos bzung ba la/ sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i dbyings de/ bde gshegs snying po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ chos sku dang*/ de bzhin nyid dang*/ rigs dang rnam pa gsum mo// dang po chos kyi sku ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dngos yin/ de sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod par bshad pa de/ btags pa ba yin/ gnyis pa de bzhin nyid ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ sems can gnyis ka'i snying po dngos yin la/

gnyis ka'i rgyud la yod par bshad pa de mtshan nyid pa yin/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs ni/ sems can gyi snying po dngos yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po btags pa ba yin/ 'di la khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po zhes kyang bya ste/ sems can gyi khams kyang yin la sangs rgyas kyi snying por yang 'gyur du rung ba'i phyir/ mdor na sems can gyi rgyud kyi sems kyi chos nyid gcig nyid/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i cha nas rigs dang khams zhes bya/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i cha nas bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa sgrub pa'i dmigs pa bshad pa la/ sgrub pa'i sgro 'dogs bcad par bya ba'i dmigs pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba'i dmigs pa gnyis/ dang po la/ theg chen sgrub pas sgro 'dogs gcad par bya ba'i gzhi de/ theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni shes bya thams cad la bya zhing*/ sde tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum/ lung du bstan pa gang zhig dam pa rnams kyi blang bar 'os pa de/ dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na mngon pa gong ma las/ bcu gsum du bshad la/ 'og ma ltar na/ ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba/ mtshungs ldan gyi dge ba/ kun slong gi don dam pa'i dge ba'o// dang po ni/ dad pa la sogs bcu gcig la bya/ gnyis pa ni/ de dang mtshungs ldan du byung ba'i sems dang sems byung la bya/ gsum pa des kun nas slangs pa'i lus ngag gi las la bya/ bzhi pa ni/ de bzhin nyid la bya'o// lung du bstan pa gang zhig skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis dor bar bya ba de/ mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ mngon pa gong ma las bcu gnyis/ 'og ma ltar na snga ma ltar bzhi las/ dang po ni/ 'dod pa khams kyi 'jig mthar gnyis ma gtogs pa'i rtsa nyon rnams la bya/ gnyis pa ni de dang mtshungs ldan du byung ba'i sems dang sems las byung ba la bya/ gsum pa des kun nas slang ba'i lus ngag gi las la bya/

bzhi pa 'khor ba thams cad la bya/ dge mi dge gang du yang lung bstan mi nus pa'i chos de/ lung ma bstan gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gong ma las bcu bzhir bshad la/ 'og ma ltar na snga ma ltar bzhi las/ dang po ni/ khams gong gi rtsa nyon dang nye nyon/ 'dod pa khams kyi 'jig mthar lhan skyes rnams yin no// gnyis pa ni/ de dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i chos rnams so// 'dir don dam pa'i dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum ni btags pa ba yin no// yang lung ma bstan la dbye na/ sgrib pas lung ma bstan dang*/ ma sgrib pas lung ma bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyon mongs can gyi yid dang*/ khams gong gi nyon mongs lta bu la bya/ gnyis pa ni/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa dang*/ nam mkha' lta bu la bya'o// dge ba la dbye na/ 'jig rten pa'i rtogs pa dge ba dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rtogs pa dge ba gnyis/ so so skye bo'i sas bsdus kyi dge ba dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'phags pa'i sas bsdus kyi dge ba de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba la dbye na/ zag bcas kyi dge ba dang*/ zag med kyi dge ba gnyis su yod la/ zag med kyi dge ba la yang 'dus byas lam bden dang*/ 'dus ma byas 'gog bden gnyis yod la/ 'dus ma byas la yang thun mong ba'i yon tan dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan gnyis yod do// 'dir zag bcas dang zag med kyi don la/ mngon pa gong ma las zag pa'i sgo drug gang rung dang 'brel ma 'brel la zag bcas dang zag med du bshad/ mngon pa 'og ma las/ zag pa dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gang rung gi sgo nas rgyas par 'gyur mi 'gyur la de gnyis su bshad pa dang*/ 'phags seng gi mnyam bzhag la zag med dang*/ rjes thob la zag bcas su bshad pa rnams las/ 'dir ni mngon pa gong ma dang mthun pa yin te/ 'grel pa las bdag tu lta ba'i gnyen po byed mi byed kyi sgo nas der bzhag pa'i phyir ro// zag pa'i sgo drug ni/

zag pa'i bdag nyid/ zag pa dang 'brel ba/ zag pas bcing pa/ zag pa dang rjes su 'brel ba/ zag pa dang rjes su mthun pa/ zag pa'i rgyu las byung ba dang drug go /dang po ni/ rtsa nyon dang nye nyon rnams te/ zag pa dngos yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de dang mtshungs ldan du byung ba'i sems sems byung rnams so// gsum pa ni/ nyon mongs pas bcings pa'i zag bcas kyi las lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ kun gzhi'i steng gi zag pa snga mas phyi ma bskyed pa'i nus pa lta bu/ lnga pa ni/ gang la dmigs nas zag pa skye ba'i yul lta bu/ drug pa ni/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po lnga lta bu/ mdor na lam gyi bden pa rnams ni zag med dang*/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po lnga lta bu la zag bcas su bzhag go /lhag ma rnams rtogs par sla'o// gnyis pa ched du bya ba'i dmigs pa la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba'o// gang gi dbang du byas nas theg chen sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i thob bya mthar thug de/ theg chen bsgrub pa'i ched du bya ba'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ sems chen po/ spong ba chen po/ rtogs pa chen po dang gsum/ rang gang la ldan pa'i gang zag de sems can kun gyi nang nas mchog nyid du byed pa'i sems bskyed de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rdo rje lta bu'i sems bskyed dang*/ mi 'gul ba'i sems bskyed dang*/ phan bde'i sems bskyed dang*/ chos la kun dga' ba'i sems bskyed rnams la zer ro// de yang 'phags pa ltar na/ ji skad bshad pa'i sems de rnams sems chen po yin par 'dod do// slob dpon ltar na/ ji skad bshad pa'i sems de rnams mdo las byang sems kyi rgyud la yod par bshad pas/ des sems chen po nyid sgrub pa byed pa yin gyi/ sems chen po nyid ma yin par bzhed/ mdor na 'dir bstan gyi chen po gsum po de mdo'i dngos stan la byang sems kyi rgyud la yod par bshad de/ sems dpa' chen por 'jog par byed pa'i chos su gsungs pa'i phyir/

bstan bcos las/ sangs rgyas kyi sar bshad de/ nges 'byung sgrub pa'i 'byung sa mthar thug tu gsungs pa'i phyir sgrib gnyis ma lus par spangs pa'i spangs pa mthar thug de/ spong ba chen po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sangs rgyas sa'i spangs pa lta bu la zer/ ji lta ji snyed kyi shes bya ma lus par rtogs pa'i rtogs pa mthar thug de/ rtogs pa chen po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes lta bu la zer/ phyi ma 'di gnyis kyi mtshan nyid kyi zur du rang gang la ldan pa'i gang zag zhes sbyor ba ni/ mdo dang mi mthun no// de lta na/ chen po dang po ni ched du bya ba spyi tsam pa yin la/ phyi ma gnyis ni spangs rtogs so sor phye ba yin no// gnyis pa sgrub pa'i dbye ba ston par byed pa la/ dbye gzhi dang*/ dbye ngo gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa tsam de rten/ theg chen sems bskyed la gnas nas/ 'bras bu byang chub chen po'i ched du rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po brtsom pa'i bya ba'o// de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ mkhyen gsum spyi'i sgrub pa dang*/ sbyor bzhi bye brag gi sgrub pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid ni/ yul skye med gsum la nyams len gtso bor gyur pa'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi sgrub pa'o// de ni bshad bya dngos brgyad kyi ldog pa nas bshad pa'i theg chen gyi sgrub pa lta bu'o// yul can pha rol tu phyin pa drug la nyams len gtso bor gyur pa'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i sgrub pa de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni 'chad byed don bdun cu'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i sgrub pa lta bu'o// yang na skye med gsum la thos bsam gtso bor gyur pa'i sgrub pa de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni theg chen tshogs lam pa'i gnas skabs kyi sgrub pa lta bu la bya/ 'di la sgrub pa bzhi'i dbye ba med do// skye med gsum la sbyor ba bzhi'i rim pas nyams len gtso bor gyur pa'i sgrub pa de/

gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i sgrub pa nas/ skad cig sbyor ba'i sgrub pa'i bar bzhi yod cing*/ go cha'i sgrub pa sogs kyang 'di las che ba yin/ 'dir mngon par rtogs pa bdun dang 'brel ba'i sgrub pa bshad nas/ chos sku dang 'brel ba'i sgrub pa ma bshad de/ de ni 'bras bu'i ldog pa nas bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa la sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ go cha'i sgrub pa/ 'jug pa'i sgrub pa/ tshogs kyi sgrub pa/ nges 'byung gi sgrub pa dang bzhi'o// dang po la/ mtshan nyid ni/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig go cha'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa'i bya ba/ sa mtshams byang sems kyi tshogs lam nas sa bcu'i bar na yod do// de la lus kyi sgo nas dbye na/ sbyin pa'i go sgrub la sogs drug rnam mkhyen yid byed dang ldan pa'i sgo nas sbyin pa'i phar phyin de drug ldan du nyams su len pa la go cha'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa'i bya ba de/ sbyin pa'i go sgrub kyi mtshan nyid de bzhin du gzhan la yang sbyar bar bya'o// rgyas par phye na sum cu so drug go /zhar la phyin drug gi rnam par bzhag pa la/ srid zhi gnyis kyi pha rol tu phyin par byed pa'am/ pha rol tu phyin pa gang rung gis bsdus pa'i mkhyen pa de/ phar phyin tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na drug las/ dang po la/ gtong ba'i sems dpa' chos bzhi ldan de sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ chos bzhi ni/ mi mthun phyogs ser sna dang bral ba/ grogs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ 'bras bu gzhan gyi 'dod pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ byed las theg pa gsum gyi skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du sems can smin par byed pa/ de la dbye na/ chos kyi sbyin pa/ zang zing gi sbyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang gsum/ 'chal tshul spong ba'i sems dpa' chos bzhi ldan de/

tshul khrims kyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ chos bzhi ni/ snga ma ltar sbyar ro// de la dbye na/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos bsdud kyi sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang gsum/ rgyud mi 'khrugs pa'i sems byung chos bzhi ldan de/ bzod pa'i phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa'i sdug bsngal dang len gyi/ chos la nges par sems pa'i bzod pa gsum/ dge ba la spro ba'i sems byung ches bzhi ldan de/ brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ go cha'i brtson 'grus/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus/ sems can don byed kyi brtson 'grus dang gsum/ dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa'i chos bzhi ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin de/ bsam gtan gyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ rtog dpyod gnyis ka dang bcas pa'i bsam gtan/ rtog med dpyod tsam gyi bsam gtan/ rtog dpyod gnyis ka med pa'i bsam gtan dang gsum/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo chos bzhi ldan de/ shes rab kyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab gsum mam/ yang na kun rdzob la dmigs pa'i shes rab/ don dam la dmigs pa'i shes rab/ sems can gyi don la dmigs pa'i shes rab dang gsum mo// gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig 'jug yul theg chen la 'jug pa'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa'i 'jug pa'i bya ba de/ 'jug sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ de la 'jug yul gyi sgo nas dbye na dgu/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi sbyor lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do// zhar la 'jug yul theg chen gyi rnam par gzhag pa la/ bgrod bya'am bgrod byed gang rung gang zhig chen po bdun dang ldan pa de/ 'jug yul theg chen gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ dgu las/ dang po/ bsam gtan dang*/ gzugs med kyi rnam par bzhag pa la/ bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug bshad pa dang*/ gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug bshad pa'o// dang po la/

mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis yan lag gi sgo nas 'og sa las nges par 'byung ba'am/ 'byung bzhin pa'i mnyam gzhag gi sas bsdus de/ bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na nyer bsdogs dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis/ yan lag gi sgo nas 'og sa la 'dod chags dang bral bar byed pa'i snyoms 'jug gang zhig rang rang gi dngos gzhi thob byed kyi sbyor ba'i ngo bor skyes pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ bsam gtan dang po'i/ gnyis pa'i/ gsum pa'i/ bzhi pa'i nyer bsdogs dang bzhi'o// dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ rtog dpyod gang rung gi sgo nas/ 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral bar byed pa'i snyoms 'jug gang zhig bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi thob byed kyi sbyor ba'i ngo bo skyes pa de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs zag med dang*/ dag pa ba gnyis/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs gang zhig bden pa'i rnam pa can du skyes pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs yin na/ 'das lam yin mi dgos te/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs sbyor lam gyi ngo bor skyes pa yang yod pa'i phyir ro// nyer bsdogs lhag ma rnams zag med mdo/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs gang zhig zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyi dge ba rtse gcig pa de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa yid la byed pa/ mos pa las byung ba/ rab tu dben pa yid la byed pa/ dga' ba bsdud pa yid la byed pa/ spyod pa yid la byed pa/ sbyor ba'i mtha' yid la byed pa dang drug go /rtog dpyod gnyen po'i yan lag gi 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po la zhi rags su lta ba'i thos bsam 'dres ma'i yid byed dang po de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rtog dpyod gang rung gi sgo nas 'dod pa dang*/ bsam gtan dang po'i skyon yon la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i yid byed gnyis pa de/

gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs pa chen po gsum spong bar byed pa'i yid byed gsum pa de/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs pa 'bring po gsum spong bar byed pa'i yid byed de bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs pa phal cher spangs shing rang rgyud la 'dod pa'i nyon mongs yod dam med dpyod par byed pa'i yid byed de/ lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs pa chung ngu gsum spong bar byed bzhin pa'i nyer bsdogs kyi ngo bor skyes pa'i yid byed de/ drug pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dis nyer bsdogs lhag ma rnams kyi yid byed drug gi mtshan nyid kyang rtogs par bya'o// yan lag gi sgo nas/ 'og sa las nges par 'byung zin pa'i bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs yin par 'gal ba de/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi la sogs pa bzhi'o// rtog dpyod gang rung gi gnyen po'i yan lag gis 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral bar byas pa'i bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' bde phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa de/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ dngos gzhi tsam po dang*/ dngos gzhi khyad par can gnyis/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi gang zhig rtog dpyod gnyis ka la chags pa dang ma bral ba de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig rtog pa la chags pa dang bral la/ dpyod pa tsam dang bcas pa de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ nang rab tu dwang ba gnyen po'i yan lag gis zag pa dang bcas pa'i rtog dpyod gnyis la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa dga' bde phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa de/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ bsam gtan dang po gnyis kyi sas bsdus kyi dga' bde gnyis kyi khyad par la bye brag tu smra ba ltar na/

sems shin tu sbyangs pa las byung ba'i yid bde'i dbang po de/ dga' ba'i mtshan nyid/ lus shin tu sbyangs pa las byung ba'i bde ba de/ bde ba'i mtshan nyid tu 'dod do// rnal 'byor spyod pa ba ltar na/ yid shes 'khor gyi tshor ba sim par nyams su myong ba gcig nyid/ dbang po rten bcas kyi lus la phan 'dogs pa'i cha nas bde ba dang*/ yid shes 'khor bcas dga' rnams kyis tshim par byed pa'i cha nas dga' ba zhes 'jog go /dran shes bzhin gtang snyoms gnyen po'i yan lag gis/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i sas bsdus kyi dga' ba nyon mongs can la 'dod chags dang bral bar byas pa'i bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig dga' ba med pa'i bde ba phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa de/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ 'dir bde ba ni sems kyi tshor ba sim par nyams su myong ba cig yin la/ 'dir dga' ba nyon mongs can dang bral bas yid dga' bar mi byed kyi lus la phan 'dogs par byed pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i mdor/ bde ba lus kyi myong la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dran pa yongs dag dang btang snyoms yongs dag gnyen po'i yan lag gnyis kyis bsam gtan gsum pa'i sas bsdus kyi bde ba la 'dod chags dang bral bar byas pa'i bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig tshor ba btang snyoms phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa de/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ dmigs rnam gyi sgo nas/ 'og sa las nges par 'byung ba'am/ 'byung bzhin pa'i snyoms 'jug de/ gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ nyer bsdogs dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis/ dmigs rnam gyi sgo nas gzugs la 'dod chags dang bral bar byed bzhin pa'i gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug de/ gzugs med kyi nyer bsdogs kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ nam mkha'i nyer bsdogs la sogs pa bzhi/ chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar mtha' yas so snyam pa'i 'du shes kyis gzugs la 'dod chags dang bral bar byed bzhin pa'i snyoms 'jug de/

nam mkha'i nyer bsdogs kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dis nyer bsdogs lhag ma rnams kyi mtshan nyid kyang bsgre bar byas shing*/ de la dbye na/ mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa yid la byed pa sogs drug skabs 'dir nam mkha'i 'du shes la zhi ba dang*/ gzugs kyi 'du shes la rags par lta ba yin no// yan lag mi 'dra ba dang bral ba'i dmigs rnam gyi sgo nas 'og sa la 'dod chags bral zin pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel de/ gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na gzugs med nam mkha'i dngos gzhi la sogs pa dang bzhi'o// nam mkha'i 'du shes kyis gzugs la 'dod chags dang bral bar byas pa'i gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig nam mkha'i 'du shes dang ma bral ba de/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ nam mkha'i yul can gyi rnam shes de nyid kyang mtha' yas so snyam pa'i 'du shes kyis nam mkha' la chags bral byas zin pa'i gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig rnam shes kyi 'du shes dang ma bral ba de/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ bzung bya ci yang med do snyam pa'i 'du shes kyis/ rnam shes kyi 'du shes la chags bral byas zin pa'i gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig ci yang med pa'i 'du shes dang ma bral pa de/ ci yang med pa'i de'i mtshan nyid/ 'du shes yod min med min gyi sgo nas 'du shes rags pa la chags bral byas zin pa'i gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug de/ srid rtse'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ mngon pa 'og ma pa ltar na/ gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug yin na/ gzugs la 'dod chags dang bral bas khyab la/ gong ma ltar na ma khyab pa yin no// yang snyoms 'jug la ngo bo'i sgo nas dngos btags ma phye bar dbye na/ snyoms 'jugs dag pa ba dang*/ snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can/ snyoms 'jug zag med dang gsum/

dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ mnyam par gzhag pa'i sas bsdus kyi 'jig rten pa'i dge ba rtse gcig pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'di la rgyu 'bras kyi sgo nas dbye na/ rgyu'i snyoms 'jug dang*/ 'bras bu'i snyoms 'jug gnyis/ rang sa khams gong ma'i skye ba 'phen 'grub gang rung gi rgyur gyur pa'i 'jig rten pa'i snyoms 'jug de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ khams gong ma'i skye ba 'phen byed kyi snyoms 'jug dang*/ 'grub byed kyi snyoms 'jug gnyis/ dang po ni nyer bsdogs dag pa brgyad kyi ngo bor skyes pa'i sems pa rnams yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug dag pa brgyad kyi ngo bor skyes pa'i sems sems byung rnams so// 'dir rgyu'i snyoms 'jug la zag med dang*/ nyon mongs can mi srid de/ rnam smin gyi rgyu yin na/ lung ma bstan dang zag med min dgos pa'i phyir/ skye ba snga mar rgyu'i snyoms 'jug sgom pa'i rnam smin gyis thob pa'i rgyu mthun gyi snyoms 'jug de/ 'bras bu'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ 'dir rnam smin dngos ni/ khams gong ma'i 'gro ba de yin la/ de'i rgyud kyi snyoms 'jug de la 'bras bu'i snyoms 'jug ces bya zhing*/ de la dag pa ba zag med/ nyon mongs can dang gsum yod do// snyoms 'jug dag pa ba la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ nyams pa cha mthun/ gnas pa cha mthun/ khyad par cha mthun/ nges 'byed cha mthun dang bzhi/ mtshan nyid rim pa bzhin du dag pa ba'i snyoms 'jug gang zhig 'jug thogs su nyon mongs skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa de gang zhig 'jug thogs su rang sa'i dag pa skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa de gang zhig 'jug thogs su gong sa'i snyoms 'jug skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa de gang zhig 'jug thogs su zag med kyi lam skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa/ snyoms 'jug gi rdzas rgyun gang zhig rags pa'i nyon mongs kyis rab tu ma zhi bar byas pa de/

snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ sred pa shas che ba'i snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can/ lta ba shas che ba'i snyoms 'jug nga rgyal shas che ba'i snyoms 'jug the tshom shas che ba'i snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can dang bzhi/ rang sa'i snyoms 'jug gi ba la ro myang ba'i sred pas ma zhi bar byas ba'i snyoms 'jug gi rdzas rgyun de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang sa'i lta ba ngan pas ma zhi bar byas pa'i snyoms 'jug gi rdzas rgyun de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ snyoms 'jug gi rdzas rgyun gang zhig rang sa'i nga rgyal gyis ma zhi bar byas pa de/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ snyoms 'jug gi rdzas rgyun gang zhig thar lam la yid gnyis za ba'i the tshom gyis ma zhi bar byas pa de/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can de rnams sngar gyi snyoms 'jug gi rdzas rgyun yin pa la der btags pa tsam yin gyi/ mtshan nyid pa ni ma yin te/ snyoms 'jug gi yan lag rnams dang mi ldan pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang*/ nyon mongs can la dga' bde dang*// rab dang shes bzhin dran pa dang*// btang snyoms dran pa dag pa med// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// nyer bsdogs yin na nyon mongs can ma yin dgos te/ nyon mongs can gyis 'og ma la chags bral byed mi nus pa'i phyir ro// mnyam par bzhag pa'i sas bsdus kyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig bden pa'i rnam pa can de/ snyoms 'jug zag med kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ bsam gtan sa drug zag med dang po gsum ste/ zag med sa dgu'o// bsam gtan sa drug ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs/ dngos gzhi tsam po/ de'i dngos gzhi khyad par can dngos gzhi phyi ma gsum dang drug go /nyer bsdogs phyi ma rnams la ni zag med mi srid de/ lam sla ba dngos gzhi la brten pa dbang bzhin du/ lam dka' ba nyer bsdogs la mi brten pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa lam la/ thar par bgrod pa'i go skabs phye shul tu gyur pa'i mkhyen pa de/

lam tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mi slob lam mo// theg pa rang lugs kyi sems bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ rang lugs kyi drod ma skyes gong gi bdag med la thos bsam gtso bor gyur pa'i so skye'i mngon rtogs de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ nyan thos kyi/ rang rgyal gyi/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam dang gsum mo// theg pa rang lugs kyi tshogs lam gyi rtogs pa rdzogs rjes su byung zhing*/ bdag med la don spyi'i tshul gyi sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i mngon rtogs de/ sbyor lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na gsum/ theg pa rang lugs kyi bdag med mngon du gsar du mthong ba'i bden pa mngon rtogs de/ mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na gsum/ theg pa rang lugs kyi bdag med rgyun ldan du sgom par byed pa'i rjes la mngon rtogs de sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na gsum/ theg pa rang lugs kyi bdag med mngon tu rtogs pa mthar thug pa de/ mi slob pa'i lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na gsum/ lam gsum po so so'i mtshan nyid kyang bdag med gsum po so so dang sbyar nas shes par bya'o// yang lam la dbye na/ sbyor ba'i lam/ bar chad med pa'i lam/ rnam par grol ba'i lam/ khyad par gyi lam dang bzhi/ rang gi ngo skol gyi spangs bya'i sa bon gyi cha shas re re nas spong bar byed pa'i lam de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon ma lus par spong bar byed pa'i lam de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon drungs phyung ba'i gnas 'gyur gsar pa sngon du byas pa'i lam de/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ rnam grol lam snga ma'i spangs rtogs khyad par du byed pa'i lam de/ khyad par gyi lam gyi mtshan nyid/ spang bya gcig gi sa bon drungs 'byin par nus pa'i lam gcig la ltos te lam rim bzhin 'jog pa yin te/

dper na/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam de/ theg chen mthong lam la ltos pa'i sbyor ba'i lam dang*/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod de/ bar chad med pa'i lam dang*/ chos shes de rnam par grol ba'i lam dang*/ rjes bzod rjes shes lta bu khyad par gyi lam yin no// gsum pa/ tshad med la/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas/ dmigs yul sems can tshad med pa la rten nas/ phan par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ tshad med kyi mtshan nyid/ yang na khyad par bzhi ldan gyi tshangs pa'i gnas pa'o// de skad du yang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bstan pa'i tshangs pa mi mthun spangs// rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan// dmigs pa rnam pa gsum la 'jug /sems can rnams ni yongs smin byed// ces so// de la dbye na/ byams pa tshad med/ snying rje tshad med/ dga' ba tshad med/ btang snyoms tshad med dang bzhi/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas sems can tshad med pa bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la rten te sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi zhi lhag zung 'brel de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la rten te/ de bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi zhi lhag zung 'brel de gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la rten te de bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang bral bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi zhi lhag zung 'brel de bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ de re re la sems can la dmigs pa'i byams pa dang*/ chos la dmigs pa'i byams pa dang*/ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i byams pa la sogs pa re re la gsum gsum du dbye bas bcu gnyis so// dang po ni/ dmigs yul sems can rdzas yod la dmigs nas bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ phung po chos tsam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sems can la dmigs nas bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can dang*/

gsum pa ni/ sgyu ma lta bu'i sems can la dmigs nas bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can cig yin la/ de bzhin du lhag ma rnams la yang sbyar ro// sa mtshams la tshad med tsam ni phyi rol pa nas sangs rgyas pa'i bar na yod/ bye brag tu sems can la dmigs pa ni phyi rol pa dang thun mong ba/ chos la dmigs pa ni nyan rang dang thun mong ba/ dmigs med la dmigs pa ni/ byang sems kyi thun mong ma yin pa'o// gsum pa tshogs sgrub la mtshan nyid ni/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig rang 'bras gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi byang chen gang rung dngos su 'dzin pa'i rgyu tshogs de/ tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ 'dir rtogs dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa la/ zhi gnas dang*/ lhag mthong bshad/ ye shes kyi tshogs bshad/ gzungs bshad/ sa bcu bshad/ gnyen po'i tshogs bshad pa'o// dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhig lus sems shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde bas khyad par du byas pa de/ zhi gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu zhi gnas las byang ba'i bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ lhag mthong gi de la dbye na/ so sor rtog pa'i lhag mthong dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i lhag mthong gnyis/ stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i ye shes de/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ stong nyid nyi shu rtogs pa'i yul can ye shes nyi shu'o// bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la rten nas/ rang gi khong du chud pa'i chos mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ gzungs kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ tshig gi gzungs/ don gyi gzungs/ bzod pa'i gzungs/ sngags kyi gzungs dang bzhi'o// bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la rten nas gsung rabs yan lag bcu gnyis la sogs pa tshig mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/

dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la rten nas de'i don mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la rten nas stong pa nyid kyi don la mi skrag par 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'di ni bzod pa'i rgyu'i rgyu'i gzungs la bzod pa'i gzungs zhes bya'o// nad zhi ba la sogs pa'i don du/ sngags 'bras byin gyis rlobs pa'i mthu dang ldan pa'i dran pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dir gzungs dngos ni dran pa yin la/ de'i 'bras bur gyur pa'i yi ge la yang de'i ming gis btags nas bstan pa yin no// sa'i rnam par gzhag pa la yon tan gyi rten du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa de/ spyir sa tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ nyan thos kyi dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi dang*/ byang sems kyi sa dang gsum/ nyan thos kyi yon tan du ma'i rten du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa de/ nyan thos kyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ rigs kyi sa brgyad pa'i sa/ mthong ba'i sa/ bsrabs pa'i sa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa/ nyan thos kyi sa/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa dang brgyad/ rtogs pa'i stobs kyi dman pa'i byang chub tu rigs nges pa'i so skye'i mngon rtogs de/ rigs kyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni zhi ba bgrod pa gcig pu pa'i nyan thos dang*/ rang rgyal gyi sbyor lam lta bu la bya/ zhugs gnas gang zhig brgyad kyi nang nas dang po'i mngon rtogs de/ brgyad pa'i sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni rgyun zhugs zhugs pa'i rtogs pa lta bu'o// mthong spangs tsam spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i nyan thos kyi rtogs pa de/ mthong ba'i sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu lta bu la bya'o// phal cher la 'dod chags dang bral bas rab tu phye ba'i nyan thos kyi rtogs pa de/ bsrabs pa'i sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu lta bu'o// 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral bas rab tu phye ba'i nyan thos kyi rtogs pa de/

'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni phyir mi 'ong gi rtogs pa lta bu'o// khams gsum la 'dod cha gas dang bral bas rab tu phye ba'i nyan thos kyi rtogs pa de/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu lta bu la bya'o// theg pa gsum gyi nang nas chung ngu'i mngon rtogs de nyan thos kyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni zhugs pa lhag ma gsum lta bu la bya/ theg pa gsum gyi nang nas 'bring po'i mngon rtogs de/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni rang rgyal gyi lam lnga la bya'o// stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang snying rje zung du 'brel ba'i byang sems kyi mkhyen pa gang zhig yon tan gyi rkyen byed pa de byang sems kyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba nas/ sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin gyi bar bcu'o// sbyin pa'i phar phyin la gtso bor spyod pa'i sa de/ byang sems kyi sa dang po'i mtshan nyid/ zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi phar phyin la gtso bor spyod pa'i byang sems kyi sa de/ byang sems kyi sa bcu pa'i mtshan nyid/ zhes sbyar na gsung rabs spyi dang mthun la/ yang na bsam dang phan pa'i dngos nyid// ces pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i yongs sbyongs nyi shu'i sgo nas/ rjes thob tu sa'i dri ma sbyong bar byed pa'i sa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid yin pa nas/ smon lam dang ni mtha' yas dang*// zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i yongs sbyong bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas/ sa'i dri ma sbyong bar byed cing*/ yon tan yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i byang sems kyi sa de/ byang sems kyi sa dgu pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi 'das sa sa dgu las 'das nas/ rjes thob tu smon lam gyi mthus mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston par nus pa'i byang sems kyi sa de/ sa bcu pa'i mtshan nyid do// gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub bye brag tu bshad pa la/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig

rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon gyi dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i rgyu tshogs de/ gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ mthong spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub dang*/ sgom spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub gnyis/ rang gi ngos skal gyi spang bya mthong spangs kyi sa bon gyi dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i rgyu tshogs de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni mthong lam bar chad med lam kho na la bya/ de la dbye na/ mthong spangs gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa bzhi'i dbye bas bzhi'o// sgom spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub la yang mtshan nyid dang dbye ba de bzhin du sbyar ro// spyir gnyen po la rnam pa bzhi ste/ rnam par sun 'byin pa'i gnyen po/ spong ba'i gnyen po/ rten gyi gnyen po/ thag bsrings pa'i gnyen po'o// rang gi ngos skal gyi spang bya la thog mar nyes dmigs su lta ba'i lam de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni tshogs lam lta bu'o// rang gi ngos skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon spang bzhin pa'i lam de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ sbyor ba'i lam dang*/ bar chad med pa'i lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyor lam lta bu la bya zhing*/ gnyis pa ni/ mthong lam bar chad med pa'i lam lta bu'o// de yang sbyor ba'i lam gyis spang bya'i sa bon mgo mnon par byed cing*/ bar chad med pa'i lam gyis drungs 'byin par byed pa yin no// spangs pa'i bral ba 'dzin par byed pa'i lam de/ rten gnyen po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni rnam grol gyi lam lta bu'o// sngar spangs pa'i spang bya dang*/ rang gi sems thag bsring bar byed pa'i lam de/ thag bsring ba'i gnyen po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni khyad par gyi lam lta bu'o// bzhi pa nges 'byung gi sgrub pa la mtshan nyid ni/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig rang gi 'byung sa brgyad po gang rung du gdon mi za bar dngos su 'byung ba'i bya ba de nges 'byung sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/

dbye na nges par 'byung sa brgyad yod pa'i bye brag gis nges 'byung gi sgrub pa brgyad do// sa mtshams la nges 'byung gi sgrub pa tsam ni/ sbyor lam nas yod la/ khyad par can ni rgyun mtha'i snga logs na yod// rnam kun mkhyen pa'i mdo gzhung yid 'phrog pa// rnam gsal mngon pa'i gzhung dang gzhan gzhung gis// rnam bshad phreng bar spel gang gis brgyan de// rnam par dpyad nas 'brel chags ngag gi bshad// ces bya ba ni skabs dang po'i lus dang yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o// //thub dbang bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan bzang gis// tshangs dang dbang po'i dregs ba nyams byas nas// sa chen 'di na lham mer mdzes gyur pa// zla med ston pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis pa rgyu mkhyen pa gnyis kyi yan lag rgyas parabashad pa la/ rgyu'i gtso bo lam shes kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ de la blang dor bya ba'i yan lag gzhi shes kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ lam shes kyi yan lag dang*/ yan lag can gyi lam shes gnyis/ lam shes kyi khyad par bya byed gang gis bsdus pa'i chos de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ lam shes ma skyes pa skyes par byed pa'i yan lag dang*/ skyes nas phan 'dogs par byed pa'i yan lag gnyis sam/ lam gyi khyad par byed chos dang*/ rgyu lam shes kyi khyad par byed chos gnyis/ lam shes kyi rjes su 'gro ldog ma 'khrul ba'i rgyu de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ rgyu lam shes gang la skye ba'i rten dang*/ gang gis skyed pa'i rgyu gnyis/ gegs nga rgyal mngon gyur pa dang bral ba'i gang zag de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ lam shes skye ba'i rgyu tshogs grangs tshang ba de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ yul nges pa dang khyad par gnyis/ lhan cig byed rkyen byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ nyer len gyi rgyu rigs kyis khyab pa de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/

gnyis pa lam shes kyi khyad par byed chos la mtshan nyid ni/ lam shes dang ngo bo gcig pa'i sgo nas de la rjes su 'gro ldog mi 'khrul ba'o// dbye na/ rang bzhin dang*/ byed las gnyis/ gzhan don du srid par skye ba len pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i nyon mongs pa ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba'i rang bzhin de/ rgyu lam shes kyi rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid/ gzhan don du srid par skye ba len pa'i rgyu la gnas nas gzhan don byed pa'i las de/ rgyu lam shes kyi byed las kyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa yan lag can gyi lam shes la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ thabs khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i byang sems kyi mkhyen pa de/ skabs gnyis pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyu lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ 'og ma rnams la yang 'di'i rigs pas shes par bya'o// gnyis pa dbye ba la/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ rang rgyal gyi/ byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang gsum/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid ni/ nyan thos kyi lam gyi rtogs rigs bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa/ shes bya lam gyi rnam gzhag la/ dngos dang*/ rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gnyis/ gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du byang sems 'phags pas shes par bya ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas pa de/ shes par bya ba'i nyan thos kyi lam tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ rang rig gis shes par bya ba'i lam dang*/ gzhan rig gis shes par bya ba'i lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ byang sems rang rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs lta bu la bya/ gnyis pa ni nyan thos rang rgyud kyi lam rnams la bya'o// gnyis pa rgyu nges par 'byed cha mthun la/ gtso bor rang 'bras nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs tshang bar thob pa'i theg chen mthong lam gyi rgyu'i char gyur pa'i theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun de/

shes par bya ba'i nyan thos kyi lam gyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs mngon sum tu mthong ba'i theg chen mthong lam gyi rgyu'i char gyur pa'i/ drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog dang bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid dngos dang*/ shes bya lam gyi rnam gzhag gnyis/ rang rgyal gyi lam bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan nyid kyi zur du byang sems kyi mngon rtogs 'byar ba de/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa la/ dngos dang*/ rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gnyis/ gdul bya rang rgyal gyi rigs can rjes su bzung ba'i don du byang sems 'phags pas shes par bya ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas pa de/ shes par bya ba'i rang rgyal gyi lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ snga ma ltar gnyis so// shes par bya ba'i rang rgyal gyi lam la/ lam rang gi ngo bo'i khyad par dang*/ nyan thos kyi lam las khyad zhugs pa'i khyad par gnyis/ dang po la/ gzung rtog spong ba'i khyad par/ 'dzin rtog mi spong ba'i khyad par/ rten rigs kyi khyad par ro// rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya shes sgrib bzung rtog gi sa bon la dngos su gnod byed dam/ de spangs pa'i rnam grol lam gang rung gi rtogs rigs su gnas pa de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi ngo skal gyi spangs bya shes sgrib 'dzin rtog gi sa bon la gnod byed ma yin pa'i rtogs rigs su gnas pa de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ khyad par de gnyis dang ldan pa'i shes par bya ba'i rang rgyal gyi lam gyi rten du gyur pa'i rang bzhin gnas rigs de/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa la/ lam bgrod tshul dang*/ chos ston tshul gyi khyad par gnyis/ slob dpon gzhan la rag ma las par rang rgyal gyi sbyor lam nas rang byang chub kyi bar tshe gcig la mngon du byed nus pa de/

dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus sgra med par rang gi gdul bya la rtogs pa bskyed nus pa de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gtso bor rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi rgyu'i char gyur pa'i theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun de/ de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ der gyur pa'i drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog dang bzhi/ gsum pa la/ mtshan nyid dngos dang*/ shes bya lam gyi rnam par gzhag pa gnyis/ byang sems kyi lam bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de/ byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ zur du byang sems kyi mkhyen pa sbyar nas/ skabs gnyis par dngos su bstan pa'i byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa la/ dngos dang*/ rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ byang sems rang rgyud la bskyed nas mngon sum du bya ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas pa de/ shes par bya ba'i byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ byang sems kyi mthong lam dang*/ sgom lam gnyis/ gnyis pa ni/ gtso bor theg chen gyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i theg chen mthong lam gyi rgyur gyur pa'i theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun de byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid yin la/ de ni skabs dang por bstan zin pa'i phyir/ gnyis par ma bstan no// mdo las phan yon chen po dang ldan par dngos su bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ 'dir bstan theg chen mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug bcu drug ni/ sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa/ chos shes/
