rjes bzod rjes shes te bzhi/ de bzhin du bden pa gzhan gsum la'ang bzhi bzhir phye bas bcu drug go /so so'i ngos 'dzin la spyir bshad pa dang*/ 'dir bstan bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos nyid sngar ma rtogs gsar du rtogs pa'i ye shes gang zhig rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya sdug bsngal mthong spangs kyi sa bon drungs 'byin par nus pa'i bar chad med lam de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod kyi mtshan nyid/ rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya sdug bsngal mthong spangs las dngos su grol ba'i rnam grol gyi lam de/ theg chen mthong lam sdug bsngal chos shes kyi mtshan nyid/ ye shes snga ma gnyis 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi rgyur mngon sum du rtogs pa'i khyad par gyi lam gang zhig bzod pas bsdus pa de theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la rjes bzod kyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la rjes shes de la nges pa 'dren nus kyi theg chen gyi mthong lam gang zhig shes pas bsdus pa de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la rjes shes kyi mtshan nyid/ lhag ma gzhan rnams la yang de bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o// 'dir dngos su bstan pa bcu drug ni rim pa bzhin du/ de bzhin nyid dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dbyer med du rtogs pas mtshon nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ 'dir bstan sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi mtshan nyid yin pa dang*/ mdo la sdug bden gyi gzugs sogs chen po yin par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i bden pa mngon rtogs de/ 'dir bstan sdug bsngal la chos shes kyi mtshan nyid yin pa dang*/ sdug bden gyi gzugs sogs 'jal byed kyi tshad ma med par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis mtshon nas bstan pa'i bden pa mngon rtogs de/ 'dir bstan sdug bsngal la rjes bzod kyi mtshan nyid yin pa dang*/

sdug bden gyi gzugs sogs nam mkha' ltar tshad med par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis mtshon nas bstan pa'i bden pa mngon rtogs de/ 'dir bstan sdug bsngal la rjes shes kyi mtshan nyid/ lhag ma rnams kyi mtshan nyid kyang gzhung nyid la rnam par brtags nas sbyar bar bya'o// gnyis pa theg chen sgom lam la/ sgom lam gyi byed pa dang*/ byed pa can gyi sgom lam gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam sgom pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan/ dbye na bcu gnyis/ sa mtshams sa gnyis pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ chos nyid mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du sgom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam dang*/ zag med sgom lam gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gang zhig rjes thob dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ngo bor gyur pa/ dbye na/ mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam sogs gsum/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dngos dang*/ mos pa'i rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/ lung rigs rnam dag la brten nas yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i 'dun pa dang dbang ldan gyi tshul du mtshungs par ldan pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ dbye na/ rang don mos pa yid la byed pa'i bla na med pa'i sgom lam/ gnyis don/ gzhan don mos pa yid la byed pa'i bla na med pa'i sgom lam dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni rim pa bzhin du/ lung rigs rnam dag la rten nas yum rang don gyi 'byung gnas su dang*/ gnyis don gyi 'byung gnas su dang*/ gzhan don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i 'dun pa dang dbang ldan gyi tshul du mtshungs par ldan pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ sa mtshams rim pa bzhin du sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar dang*/

brgyad pa dang*/ dgu pa gnyis dang*/ bcu pa rnams la bzhag go /gnyis pa mos pa'i rnam gzhag la dngos dang phan yon gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid ni/ lung rig rnam dag la rten nas/ sher phyin don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ rang don mos pa/ gnyis don mos pa/ gzhan don mos pa dang gsum/ de re re la yang chung 'bring dgu dgur phye bas nyi shu rtsa bdun no// sa mtshams la mos pa tsam ni tshogs sbyor nas kyang yod la/ khyad par can gyi sa mtshams ni snga ma dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa phan yon la mtshan nyid ni/ yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i mos pa gsum gang rung sgom pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan/ dbye na/ bstod pa/ bkur ba/ bsngags pa dang gsum/ yum rang don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i sems dpa' la sangs rgyas sogs kyi yon tan brjod pa chung ngu mdzad pa de/ 'dir bstan gyi bstod pa'i mtshan nyid/ yum gnyis don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i sems dpa' la sangs rgyas sogs kyis yon tan brjod pa 'bring du mdzad pa'i ngo bor gnas pa de/ 'dir bstan bkur ba'i mtshan nyid/ yum gzhan don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i sems dpa' la sangs rgyas sogs kyis yon tan brjod pa chen po mdzad pa'i ngo bor skyes pa de 'dir bstan gyi bsngags pa'i mtshan nyid/ de re re la yang chung 'bring dgu dgur dbye bas nyi shu rtsa bdun no// gnyis pa bsngo ba yid la byed pa'i bla na med pa'i sgom lam la/ mtshan nyid dngos dang*/ bsngo ba'i rnam gzhag gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rang gzhan gyi dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sgyur bar byed pa'i 'dun pa khyad par can dang dbang ldan gyi tshul du mtshungs par ldan pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ dbye na bcu gnyis so// sa mtshams ni sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar na yod/

gnyis pa la/ rnam mkhyen yid byed dang ldan par 'khor gsum mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan dge rtsa rdzogs byang du sgyur bar byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ 'dir bstan bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid/ spyir bsngo ba tsam la mngon mtho'i rgyur bsngo ba dang*/ nges legs kyi rgyur bsngo ba gnyis yod la/ phyi ma la yang theg pa gsum gyi dbye bas rnam pa gsum mo// 'dir bstan gyi bsngo ba la khyad par can gyi bsngo ba'i ming can sogs bcu gnyis yod la/ de yang dang po dgu ni ngo bo gcig la ldog pa'i sgo nas phye ba yin zhing*/ phyi ma gsum ni chung 'bring gi sgo nas phye ba yin te/ sa mtshams la bsngo ba tsam ni tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ 'dir bstan gyi bsngo ba khyad par can ni/ sa gnyis pa nas bcu'i bar na yod/ gsum pa rjes su yi rang ba'i sgom lam la/ mtshan nyid dngos dang*/ yid rang gi rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa la mngon par dga' ba'i dad pa dang dbang ldan gyi tshul du mtshungs par ldan pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ 'di la dbye ba ma bshad la/ sa mtshams sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar ro// gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid ni/ sbyor ba rnam mkhyen yid byed dang dngos gzhi mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas/ rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa la mngon par dga' ba'i dad pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ 'dir bstan gyi rjes su yi rang gi mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs sbyor nas yod la/ spyir yi rang tsam ni theg pa gsum la yang yod do// gnyis pa zag med sgom lam la theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs gang zhig mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor skyes pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa sgom lam dang*/ rnam dag sgom lam gnyis/ dang po la/

theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam gang zhig bar chad med lam gyi ngo bor skyes pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid dngos dang*/ mdo las gsungs pa'i rnam dag gi dbye ba bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam gang zhig mnyam gzhag rnam grol lam gyi ngo bor skyes pa'o// sa mtshams sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi bral rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon spangs pas thob pa'i bral ba de/ rnam dag tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la nyan thos kyi rnam dag rang rgyal gyi/ byang sems kyi rnam dag rnam dag shin tu ba dang bzhi/ rang gi ngo skal gyi nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa tsam spangs pa'i bral ba de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na rgyun zhugs kyi/ phyir 'ong*/ phyir mi 'ong gi dgra bcom gyi rnam dag dang bzhi/ de re re la yang rnam grol lam dang*/ so sor brtags 'gog gnyis gnyis yod do// ngo skal gyi nyon sgrib dang*/ ngo skal gyi shes sgrib gzung rtog tsam spangs pas bral ba de/ rang rgyal gyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ bod snga ma rnams rgyun zhugs kyi rnam dag dang*/ dgra bcom gyi rnam dag gnyis su 'chad kyang rigs pas mi 'thad do// lam gsum phyin ci ma log pa shes pa la gegs byed du gyur pa'i ngo skal gyi sgrib pa spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i byang sems kyi bral ba de/ byang sems kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar na yod/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus par spangs pa'i bral ba de/ rnam dag shin tu ba'i mtshan nyid/ lam bral gzhan dang rang nyid kyang*// lam bzang nyid la 'jug bya'i phyir// lam gsum yan lag dang bcas pa// lam shes nyid kyi mdo bzhin bshad// ces bya ba ni skabs gnyis pa'i lus dang yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o// //shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i skyon dgongs shing*// snying rje chen pos zhi ba'i mtha' spangs nas// byang chub po'i gnas su zhugs gyur pa// 'phrin las chen po de la phyag bgyi'o// gnyis pa blang dor bya ba'i yan lag gzhi shes la/

'jug yul gzhi shes/ 'jug pa sbyor ba/ zhugs 'bras mthong lam dang gsum/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba'o// dang po ni/ lam sher phyin dang de'i gzugs brnyan gyi sher phyin gang rung de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na lam sher phyin dang*/ de'i gzugs brnyan gyi sher phyin gnyis/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang snying rje chen po zung du 'brel ba'i mkhyen pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ shes rab kyis 'khor ba la mi gnas pa'i sher phyin/ snying rjes zhi ba la mi gnas pa'i sher phyin/ de gnyis kyi byed pa sdom pas 'bras yum la nye ba'i sher phyin/ nye ba'i rgyu mtshan/ gnyen po'i sher phyin dang bzhi/ shes rab kyi 'khor ba rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi gzhi shes de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don sgrub pa'i byang sems kyi gzhi shes de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ bden gnyis rnam 'byed kyi thabs mkhas kyis zin pa'i byang sems kyi gzhi shes de gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan 'dzin gyi sa bon dngos su 'jom nus pa'i byang sems kyi gzhi shes de/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis dang bral ba'i theg dman 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs de/ gzugs brnyan gyi sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ srid zhig gang rung gi mtha' la gnas pa'i gzhi shes/ 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes/ ring ba'i rgyu mtshan/ mi mthun phyogs dang bcas pa'i gzhi shes so// 'khor 'das la blang dor gyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i theg dman gyi gzhi shes de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bden gnyis rnam 'byed kyi thabs mkhas dang bral ba'i theg dman gyi gzhi shes de/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i theg dman gyi gzhi shes/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ zhar la mtshan 'dzin gsum gyi mtshan nyid la/ gzhi phung khams skye mched la bdag med sogs su mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin de/

gzhi la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ sbyin pa nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar lam gyi dngos po la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin de/ 'dir bstan lam la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ 'bras bu de bzhin gshegs pa la thob bya mthar thug tu 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin de/ 'dir bstan 'bras bu la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan 'dzin tsam ni 'dir bstan mtshan 'dzin du mi bzung ste/ 'dir bstan mtshan 'dzin de mtshan 'dzin tsam gyi gnyen por gsungs pa'i phyir/ mdor bsdu na/ bshad ma thag pa'i mi mthun phyogs dang*/ gnyen po'i rab dbye bde blag tu rtogs pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs de/ yul can gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid yin no// de ni ji skad du/ de ltar kun shes nyid lugs la// zhes pa'i gzhung gis bstan pa yin no// gnyis pa 'jug pa sbyor ba la/ dngos dang*/ mnyam nyid gnyis/ dang po la/ dngos bstan byang sems kyi sbyor ba dang*/ shugs bstan nyan rang gi sbyor ba rnams so// dang po la/ gzugs sogs yul bcu la sgrub pa'i yongs su shes pa gsal ba'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor de/ 'dir bstan sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ yul bcu yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bcur phye la/ de yang bya dka' rnam gsum la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba gcig tu byas pa yin no// bcu po bsdu na nyi snang las/ dang po bzhi la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ phyi ma drug la sbyor ba tsam gyi tha snyad mdzad/ slob dpon gyis ni thams cad la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba tsam gyi tha snyad byas so// sa mtshams ni sbyor lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar na yod do// sbyor ba bcu po so so'i rnam gzhag la/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar na gyi rang gi ngo bo la sgrub pa yongs su shes pa gsal ba'i rnal 'byor de/

gzugs sogs la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ de nas de'i bar la rtag mi rtag tu bsgrub pa'i yongs su shes pa gsal ba'i rnal 'byor de/ de mi rtag la sogs spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ de nas de'i bar gyi rdzogs ma rdzogs la sgrub pa'i yongs su shes pa gsal ba'i rnal 'byor de/ gzugs sogs rdzogs ma rdzogs la zhen spyod bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ zhes sogs mdo dang 'grel pa la sogs la rnam par brtags nas sbyar bar bya'o// zhar la 'dir bstan gyi rdzogs ma rdzogs kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa dang*/ spyir mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ kun btags pa'i gzugs dang tshor ba dang rnam mkhyen gyi bar la ni ma rdzogs pa zhes bya ste/ blos gzugs dang tshor ba la sogs pa sgro btags pa tsam yin gyi btags pa de nyid don la med pas yon tan gyi rten du ma rdzogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtog pas sgro btags pas stong pa'i gzugs la sogs pa de bzhin nyid de la ni/ chos nyid kyi gzugs dang tshor ba la sogs pa zhes bya la/ de dag ni chos can/ rdzogs pa zhes bya ste/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin pas stobs sogs yon tan gyi rten du rdzogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ bag chags yongs su smin pa'i mthu las/ gzugs dang tshor ba la sogs par snang tsam de la/ rnam par btags pa'i gzugs zhes bya la/ de ni kun btags kyi gdags gzhi dang*/ yongs grub kyi chos can yin pas/ rdzogs ma rdzogs dpyod pa'i dpyad gzhi yin pa'i phyir dngos su ma bstan la/ 'on kyang gzugs sogs kyi ngo bo la/ spyod pa bkag pa'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i gzhi bstan pa de yin no// gnyis pa spyir mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam par bzhag pa la/ rnam rig pa'i lugs dang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po la/ don la med bzhin du rtog pas sgro btags pa'i cha de kun btags kyi mtshan nyid/

dbye na/ rnam grangs pa'i kun btags dang*/ mtshan nyid yongs su chad pa'i kun btags gnyis te/ dang po ni/ chos chos can/ bsgrub bya sgrub byed/ spyi dang bye brag rnams yin no// gnyis pa ni/ gang zag gi bdag lta bu'o// rgyu rkyen gzhan gyi dbang las skyes pa de gzhan dbang gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ dag pa gzhan dbang dang*/ ma dag pa gzhan dbang gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam byang gi phyogs dang mthun pa'i shes pa rnams la bya/ gnyis pa ni/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i shes pa rnams la bya/ rnam dag gi dmigs pa de yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ 'gyur med yongs grub dang*/ phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes la bya/ gnyis pa ni/ gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ bzung ba chos kyi bdag med la bya/ mtshan gzhi'i dbye ba de dang ni dngos btags so sor ma phye ba'i dbang du byas na mngon pa gong ma las gsungs la/ dngos btags so sor phye ba'i dbang du byas na/ sgro 'dogs byed kyi rtog pa'i ngor yod pas tha snyad du yod cing*/ btags pa ltar rdzas su med pas don la med pa'i chos de/ kun btags kyi mtshan nyid/ de ni bdag nyid kyi don spyi dang*/ gzugs sgra la sogs pa phyi rol gyi skye mched rnams so// gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba'i yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa de/ gzhan dbang gi mtshan nyid/ gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong pa'i de kho na nyid de yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid/ de skad du yang*/ theg bsdus las/ rnam par rtog pas btags pa'i don// kun du btags pa'i ngo bo nyid// rnam par rtog pa gzhan gyi dbang*// de'i chos nyid yongs su grub// gnyis pa dbu ma'i lugs la/ spyir dbu ma'i gzhung las/ mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam gzhag rgyas par ma gsung kyang*/ 'grel chen dang*/ dbu ma snang ba las/ phyogs tsam gsung ba'i don blangs na/ chos rnams kyi steng du rtog pas sgro btags pa'i cha de/

kun btags kyi mtshan nyid/ sgro 'dogs pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i rten rten 'byung sgyu ma lta bu de gzhan dbang*/ chos can sgyu ma lta bu'i steng du ji ltar sgro btags pas stong pa'i stong nyid de/ yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid do// gnyis pa shugs bstan nyan rang gi sbyor ba la/ mtshan nyid ni/ gzugs sogs yul bcu la sgrub pa'i yongs su shes pa dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// mdor na nyan rang gi sbyor ba 'di sngar bshad pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi sher phyin la 'jug par byed cing*/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen dang ring bar byed de/ byang sems kyi sbyor bas ni bshad ma thag pa'i lam sher phyin la 'jug par byed cing 'bras bu rnam mkhyen dang nye bar byed pa yin no// gnyis pa sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid la/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar la rlom pa rnam pa bzhi bkag nas sgom pa'i sems pa'i rnal 'byor de'i mtshan nyid do// rlom pa rnam pa bzhi ni/ gzugs la sogs pa'i ngo bo la mngon par zhen pa dang*/ khyad par sngon po la sogs pa'i mtshan mar zhen pa dang*/ gzugs rnam pa nyi shu la sogs pa'i dbye ba la mngon par zhen pa dang*/ nges 'byed cha mthun la sogs pa rtogs pa'i rlom pa bkag nas sgom pa'o// ji skad du/ mdo las/ gzugs rlom sems su mi byed/ gzugs kyis rlom sems su mi byed/ gzugs bdag gis zhes rloms sems su mi byed/ gzugs la rlom sems su mi byed ces pa'i don no// gsum pa zhugs 'bras mthong lam la/ dngos bstan byang sems kyi dang*/ shugs bstan theg dman gyi mthong lam mo// mdo las/ sgro 'dogs so gnyis dang bral ba'i rnam pa can du bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ skabs gsum par bstan pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug sdug bden gyi gzugs sogs rtag mi rtag spros pa dang bral bar mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis mtshon pas bstan pa'i theg gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/

'dir bstan pa'i sdug bsngal la chos bzod kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ tshor ba bde sdug gi spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi dang*/ don gzhan gyi bdag gis stong pa'i stong nyid spros pa dang bral bar mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi dang*/ ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag yod med kyi spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis mtshon nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ 'dir bstan rjes shes kyi mtshan nyid/ ces sogs gzhung nyid la brtags nas sbyar te shes par bya'o// gnyis pa la/ mi rtag la sogs bcu drug gi rnam par can du sgro 'dogs pa'i theg dman gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de shugs bstan nyan rang gi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ zhar la skabs gsum pa rim ston rgyu'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du sgom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ de 'dra'i sgom lam de ni mi dmigs pas skabs gsum pa 'dir ma bstan pa yin no// gzhi yi gnas lugs ji ltar shes pa yi// gzhi lam rnam gsum mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i blo// gzhi nas spangs te lam la 'jug pa'i tshul// gzhi shes ston pa'i mdo bzhin legs par bshad// ces bya ba ni skabs gsum pa'i lus dang yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o// //skye med gsum la thos dang bsam pa yis// rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros brgya phrag gis// yun du gom pas nyes kun rgyang bsrings te// mthon po'i go 'phang brnyes nger phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis pa nyams su len pa'i thabs sbyor ba bzhi bshad pa la/ dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ brtan pa rgyu 'bras kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyu rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i yan lag rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ 'bras bu rtse sbyor gyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la/

spyir theg chen gyi sbyor ba la/ 'jug tshul gtan la dbab pa dang*/ bye brag tu rnam rdzogs sbyor ba rgyud la skyes pa'i sgom lam rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po la/ mtshon bya theg chen gyi sbyor ba bshad pa dang*/ de'i mtshan nyid kyis mtshon pa'i tshul bshad pa'o// dang po la/ bsgom bya rnam par bshad pa dang*/ sgom pa po'i gang zag gi rnam pa de bsgom par byed pa'i rnal 'byor bshad pa'o// dang po la spyir bshad pa dang*/ skabs su bab pa'i rnam pa bshad pa'o// dang po la/ yul gyi khyad par de rnam pa tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ don rnam dang*/ shes rnam gnyis/ shes pas khyad par du ma byas pa'i don gyi rnam pa de/ don rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na mi rtag la sogs bcu drug gi lta ba gang zag gi bdag med nyid kyi don rnam dang*/ rang bzhin skye med lta bu chos kyi bdag med kyi don rnam gnyis/ yul la dmigs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par de shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na mi mthun phyogs kyi shes rnam dang*/ gnyen po'i shes rnam gnyis/ yul la phyin ci log tu zhugs pa'i blo de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sgra rtag 'dzin rtog pa lta bu'o// yul gnas tshul dang mthun par zhugs pa'i blo'i 'dzin stangs de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sgrib par rtogs pa'i rtogs pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa la/ bden bzhi gang rung rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs de 'dir bstan gyi theg chen sbyor ba'i bsgom bya shes rnam kyi mtshan nyid/ 'di la yang dngos btags kyi sgo nas dbye na/ mtshan nyid pa byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa dang*/ rjes mthun pa nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi rgyud la yod pa'o// dang po ni/ byang sems rang rgyud la yod pa'i skye med gsum gang rung rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs la bya/ gnyis pa ni/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi rgyud la yod pa'i skye med gsum rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs la bya'o// mtshan btags kyi khyad par de bzhin du 'thad pa yin no// sgom pa po'i blo de nyid sgom byed kyi rnam pa de'i ngo bor bskyed pa la rnam pa bsgom pa'i don du 'jog pa'i phyir/

yul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ gzhi shes kyi shes rnam/ lam shes kyi shes rnam/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam dang gsum/ gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i gzhi shes kyi shes rnam dang*/ bdag med gnyis ka rtogs pa'i gzhi shes kyi shes rnam gnyis/ chos can gyi sgo nas dbye na/ bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa bcu gnyis dang*/ lam bden gyi rnam pa bco lnga ste nyer bdun no// nyer bdun bsdus na gnyis su 'dus so// mngon pa dang thun mong ba'i shes rnam dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i shes rnam gnyis/ sher phyin dang mngon pa gnyis ka las gang zag gi bdag med pa'i rnam pa can du bstan pa'i 'dzin stangs de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa bcu gnyis dang*/ nyon sgrib kyi gnyen por bstan pa'i lam bden gyi rnam pa bzhi rnams so// chos mngon pa las ma bshad cing*/ sher phyin las gzung ba chos kyi bdag med nyid rtogs pa'i cha nas bstan pa'i 'dzin stangs de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni shes sgrib bzung rtog gi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam bden gyi rnam pa bcu gcig po rnams la bya/ yang na bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa dang lam bden gyi rnam pa'o// bden pa dang po gsum gang zag gi bdag med du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi 'dzin stangs de 'dir bstan bsgom bya dang po gsum gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ sdug bden mi rtag par rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi shes rnam sogs bcu gnyis/ gzhi shes kyi lam bden las phye ba'i byang sems kyi 'dzin stangs de/ 'dir bstan gyi bsgom bya lam bden gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ 'di la brten gyi sgo nas dbye na/ nyon sgrib kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam zag med kyi rnam pa bzhi shes sgrib bzung rtog gi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam zag bcas kyi rnam pa lnga/

de'i gnyen por lam zag med nyid kyi rnam pa drug ste bco lnga/ nyon sgrib kyi gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'i mnyam gzhag gi mkhyen pa de/ 'dir bstan lam dang po'i mtshan nyid yin la/ mkhyen pa gsum de'i cha shas su gyur pa'i lam/ rigs pa/ sgrub pa/ nges 'byin bzhi'am/ byed pa po'i bdag med par rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs sogs de la lam dang po'i shes rnam zhes bya'o// de bzhin du shes sgrib bzung rtog gi gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'i rjes thob ye shes de la lam gnyis pa zhes bya/ de'i gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes de la lam gsum pa zhes bya/ lam de gnyis kyi 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par bcu gcig po de la de'i rnam pa zhes bya'o// 'dir lam dang po ni nyan rang dang byang sems thams cad la yod la/ lam phyi ma gnyis ni rang rgyal dang byang sems kho na la yod la/ de dag gi rnam pa rnams kyang de bzhin no// mdor bsdu na/ 'dir gzhi shes kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i mthong lam dang sgom lam 'dir lam bden zhes bya/ mthong lam dang bsgom lam de gnyis kyi 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag la/ lam bden gyi shes rnam zhes bya/ de yang sgom bya mtshan nyid pa ni byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa de nyid yin la/ nyan rang rgyud la yod pa ni rtogs rigs kyi rten so sor nges pa'i rnam gsal gyi dper brjod yin gyi sgom bya dngos min no// lam gyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi 'dzin stangs de 'dir bstan lam shes kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ kun 'byung bden pa'i shes rnam/ lam bden gyi/ sdug bden gyi/ 'gog bden gyi shes rnam dang bzhi/ lam shes kyi shes rnam gang zhig kun 'byung bden pa spangs gnyen gyi sgo nas bdag med gnyis ka'i rnam pa can du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs de 'dir bstan kun 'byung bden pa'i shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/

dbye na brgyad/ lam shes kyi shes rnam gang zhig lam bden dam bca' dang 'thad pa'i sgo nas bdag med gnyis ka'i rnam pa can du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ 'dir bstan lam bden gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bdun/ de gang zhig sdug bden rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas bdag med gnyis ka'i rnam pa can du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ 'dir bstan gyi sdug bden gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na lnga/ de gang zhig 'gog bden blo bur dri bral gyi ngo bo rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ 'dir bstan gyi 'gog bden gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu drug bcu drug po de yang bsdu na/ 'gog pa'i rnam pa/ zhi ba'i/ gya nom pa'i/ nges 'byung gi rnam pa dang bzhi/ blo bur rnam dag gi stong nyid dang po gsum rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi 'dzin stangs de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi stong pa nyid la sogs pa brgyad rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs de gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi stong pa nyid la sogs pa bzhi rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ mdor bsdu na/ gzhi shes kyi shes rnam ni/ gzhi shes kyi 'dzin stangs dngos sam de dang rjes su mthun pa gcig yin la/ rjes su mthun pa ni tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs na yang yod cing*/ de sgom pa la gzhi shes kyi rnam pa sgom par gzhag go /gzhi shes kyi 'dzin stangs dngos ni 'phags pa thams cad kyi rgyud la yod pa yin la/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la yod pa ni rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam du 'du/ nyan rang 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa ni spyir gzhi shes mtshan nyid pa yin kyang*/ 'dir bstan gyi bsgom bya shes rnam mtshan nyid pa min/ 'dir bstan gyi bsgom bya shes rnam ni byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa kho na'o// lam shes kyi shes rnam la yang de'i rigs pas sbyar te shes par bya'o// gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam la rnam mkhyen gyi 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid yin/

yang na/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i 'dzin stangs de gzhi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ lam shes kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs yar ldan du bsdus pa mthar thug pa'i 'dzin stangs de/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gnyis/ dang po la/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gang zhig rang gi rtogs pa'i rigs rgyun mtshan nyid pa 'phags chung 'og ma'i rgyud la yod pa de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na nyan rang dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam dang*/ byang sems dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gnyis/ dang po la/ dngos dang*/ byang phyogs so bdun gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa'o// rnam mkhyen gyi 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag gang zhig rang gi rigs 'dra mtshan nyid pa nyan rang 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi byang phyogs so bdun lta bu'o// 'dir rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam dngos ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud kyi de nyid yin la/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i bsgom bya shes rnam ni byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa'i byang phyogs so bdun po de nyid yin zhing*/ nyan rang gi rgyud la yod pa'i so bdun ni sangs rgyas kyi so bdun po de dang rjes su mthun par ston pa'i rnam gsal gyi dpe tsam yin gyi/ shes rnam dngos dang*/ bsgom bya shes rnam gnyis ka min zhing*/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam rjes mthun pa yang min te/ rnam mkhyen gyi 'dzin stangs kyi gtso bo dang rjes su mthun pa med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa byang phyogs so bdun gyi rnam par gzhag pa la/ zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i ye shes kyi phyogs dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos byang chub phyogs mthun gyi mtshan nyid/

dbye na lnga las/ dang po dran pa nyer bzhag la/ mtshan nyid ni/ lus tshor sems chos bzhi po gang rung la rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas rtog par byed pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na lus dran pa nyer gzhag la sogs pa bzhi/ phyi nang gi lus la rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis yongs su rtog par byed pa'i dang*/ tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum la rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis yongs su rtog par byed pa'i dang*/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po la rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis yongs su rtog par byed pa'i dang*/ tshor ba ma gtogs pa'i sems byung thams cad dang*/ ldan min 'du byed dang*/ 'dus ma byas kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams la rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis yongs su rtog par byed pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o// sa mtshams nyan thos kyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa yang dag spong ba la mtshan nyid/ spang gnyen blang dor byed pa'i brtson 'grus de yang dag spong ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ mi dge ba skyes pa spong ba'i dang*/ ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa'i dang*/ dge ba skyes pa spel bar byed pa'i dang*/ ma skyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i yang dag spong ba dang bzhi/ de dag gi mtshan nyid rim pa bzhin du/ kun nas nyon mongs pa skyes pa spong ba'i phyir du 'dun pa bskyed/ 'bad/ brtson 'grus brtsom/ sems rab tu 'dzin/ sems rab tu 'jog par byed pa'i brtson 'grus gnas dang bcas pa'o// zhes sbyar ro// de la 'dun pa ni brtson 'grus kyi gnas so// 'bad pa ni/ zhi gnas dang*/ rab tu 'dzin pa dang*/ btang snyoms kyi mtshan ma yid la byed pa de brtson 'grus brtsom pa'i dus dngos so// brtson 'grus brtsom pa ni/ bying rgod sel ba'i don du brtson 'grus brtsom pa de/ des spyir bstan nas ji ltar du rtsom zhe na/ bying ba na sku gzugs sogs la sems rab tu 'dzin pa dang*/

rgod pa na sems nang du rab tu 'jog pa'o// sa mtshams ni/ nyan thos kyi tshogs lam 'bring nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du'o// gsum pa rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la/ spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad dang ldan pa'i sems gnas pa las su rung ba'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na bzhi las/ gus par sbyor ba'i 'dun pa la brten nas sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ rgyun du sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus la brten nas sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de brtson 'grus gyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i mtshan nyid/ sngon gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi bag chags dang ldan pa'i sems la brten nas sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i mtshan nyid/ tshe 'dir chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab la brten nas thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dir spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad ni/ 'dun pa/ rtsol ba/ dad pa/ shin sbyangs/ dran pa/ shes bzhin/ sems pa/ btang snyoms so// nyes pa lnga spong ba'i phyir mngon par 'dus byed pas na spong ba'i 'du byed ces bya/ de las skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin de la rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa zhes bya zhing*/ 'dir rdzu 'phrul ni spyan dang mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams la bya la/ de'i rten yin pa'i phyir rkang pa zhes bya'o// nyes pa lnga ni ji skad du/ le lo dang ni gdam ngag rnams// rjed dang bying dang rgod pa dang*// 'du mi byed dang 'du byed dang*// 'di dag nyes pa lngar 'dod do// zhes pa ltar/ bying rgod gnyis po gcig tu byas pa'o// le lo'i gnyen po ni bzhi ste/ 'dun pa ni rten yin te/ rtsol ba ni de la brten pa yin/

dad pa ni 'dun pa'i rgyu yin/ shin tu sbyangs pa ni rtsol ba'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyen po phyi ma bzhi dang*/ nyes pa phyi ma bzhi spang gnyen du sbyar ro// sa mtshams ni nyan thos kyi tshogs lam chen po nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar ro// bzhi pa dbang po la/ rang 'bras 'phags lam bskyed pa la bdag por gyur pa'i mkhyen pa de dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na lnga las dbang po gang zhig bden pa rnams la/ yid ches pa'i sems byung de dad pa'i dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig bden pa bzhi bsgom pa la spro ba'i sems byung de brtson 'grus kyi dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig bden pa'i dmigs rnam mi brjed pa'i sems byung de dran pa'i dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig bden pa bzhi'i dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa'i sems byung de ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig bden pa bzhi rab tu 'byed pa'i sems byung mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de shes rab kyi dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ mtshungs ldan zhes pa kun la sbyar ro// sa mtshams nyan thos kyi drod nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod do// ma dad pa la sogs pa'i mi mthun phyogs kyis brdzi bar mi nus pa'i mkhyen pa de 'dir bstan stobs kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na dad pa'i stobs la sogs pa lnga/ dad pa'i dbang po gang zhig ma dad pas brdzi bar mi nus pa de/ dad pa'i stobs kyi mtshan nyid/ ces sogs sbyar bar bya'o// sa mtshams nyan thos kyi bzod pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod do// bden pa mngon par rtogs pa'i lam de byang chub yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ dran 'byed brtson dga' sbyangs ting 'dzin// btang snyoms byang chub yan lag bdun// zhes pa'o// mtshan nyid ni/ byang chub kyi gnas kyi yan lag tu gyur pa'i dran pa de/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag gi mtshan nyid yin pa nas/ byang chub kyi ngo bo'i yan lag tu gyur pa'i chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo dang*/

byang chub kyi nges 'byung gi yan lag tu gyur pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ byang chub kyi phan yon gyi yan lag tu gyur pa'i dga' ba dang*/ gang gis kyang nyon mongs par mi 'gyur ba'i byang chub kyi yan lag tu gyur pa'i shin sbyangs dang*/ gang du yang nyon mongs par ma gyur pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag tu gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ nyon mongs pa med pa'i ngo bo'i byang chub kyi yan lag tu gyur pa'i btang snyoms rnams so// sa mtshams nyan thos kyi mthong lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na'o// sgom spangs dag par byed pa'i mngon rtogs de/ 'phags lam yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ lta rtog ngag dang las kyi mtha'// 'tsho rtsol dran ting yan lag brgyad// ces pa'o// mtshan nyid ni rim pa bzhin du/ 'phags lam yan lag gang zhig ces sbyar na/ mnyam gzhag tu rtogs pa'i de kho na nyid nges par 'dzin pa'i blo dang*/ ji ltar rtogs pa'i don gzhan la ston pa'i ngag kun nas slong byed dang*/ rang smra ba po lta ba rnam dag tu yid ches par byed pa'i yan lag dang*/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de tshul khrims rnam dag tu yid ches par byed pa'i yan lag dang*/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de 'tsho ba rnam dag tu yid ches par byed pa'i yan lag dang*/ sgom spangs su gyur pa'i nyon sgrib kyi bag chags spong bar byed pa'i yan lag dang*/ bying rgod la sogs pa nye nyon gyi bag chags sbyong bar byed pa'i yan lag dang*/ spyan dang mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan la sgrib pa sbyong bar byed pa'i yan lag go /sa mtshams ni nyan thos kyi sgom lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod do// gnyis pa la rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gang zhig rang gi rigs 'dra mtshan nyid pa byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa de byang sems dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gnyen po'i lam la sogs pa drug

skabs 'dir rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam dngos ni/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi rnam thar sgo gsum la sogs pa so bzhi po de nyid yin la/ de dang rjes su mthun pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa so bzhi ni bsgom bya shes rnam dngos dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam rjes mthun pa tsam yin la/ nyan rang gi rgyud la yod pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ rnam thar brgyad kyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ snyoms 'jug dgu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ nyon sgrib tsam gyi gnyen po'i rigs su gnas kyi sgrib pa mtha' dag gi gnyen po'i rigs su mi gnas pas/ 'dir lam shes kyi rnam par ma bzhag pa yin no// des na 'dir bsgom bya shes rnam de nyid ngos 'dzin pa la/ gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'i byang sems kyi ye shes de gnyen po'i lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang gsum/ bdag tu lta ba dang*/ bdag gir blta ba'i gnyen por gyur pa'i byang sems kyi mkhyen pa de/ 'dir bstan rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni stong pa bdag med gnyis rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi ye shes lta bu zer la/ 'jig lta'i rgyu dang 'bras bur gyur pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i byang sems kyi ye shes de 'dir bstan rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni 'gog lam gyi rnam pa bzhi rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi ye shes lta bu la bya/ khams gsum la sred pa'i gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'i byang sems kyi mkhyen pa de 'dir bstan rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni mi rtag sdug bsngal gnyis dang*/ kun 'byung gi rnam pa bzhi rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi ye shes lta bu bya'o// gnyis pa sprul pa'i lam la bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas gzhan du sprul pa sna tshogs 'byor bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/

dbye na/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ khyad par sdug pa'i rnam thar dang gsum/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi sems rten bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas rnal 'byor pa rang la gzugs can du 'du shes pa'i sgo nas phyi rol gyi gzugs rnams la sna tshogs su blta ba yang dag par 'byor ba'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o// gnyis pa la mtshan nyid/ de la brten nas rang la gzugs can gyi 'du shes rnam par bshig pa'i sgo nas phyi rol gyi gzugs rnam la der blta ba'i zhes sogs/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid ni/ de la brten nas 'du shes gsum ldan gyi sgo nas sdug par ro gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid do// gsum pa mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa'i lam la/ rang sgom pa po'i rgyud la lus sems shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba bskrun par byed pa'i snyoms 'jug de de'i mtshan nyid do// dbye na/ thar pa dang mthun par gnas pa'i lam dang*/ zhi bar gnas pa'i lam gnyis/ thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa mngon gyur pa dang bral tsam du mtshungs pa'i lam de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gzugs med kyi rnam par thar pa bzhi/ tshor 'du rags pa zhi ba'i lam gyi rang bzhin de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa'i rnam thar gcig pu la bya'o// 'dir rnam thar dang snyoms 'jug gi khyad par la/ mngon pa 'og ma pa ltar na/ sa 'og ma la rgyab kyis phyogs pa de rnam thar gyi don dang*/ der mi phyogs pa de snyoms 'jug tsam gyi don du bzhed pas nyer bsdogs kyi bar chad med lam rnams snyoms 'jug kho na yin gyi rnam thar min la/ nyer bsdogs kyi rnam grol lam dgu pa nas dngos gzhi'i rnam thar du 'jog go /de yang bsam gtan dang po gnyis na rnam thar dang po gnyis/

rnam thar gsum pa ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i ngo bor skye bar 'dod do// mngon pa gong ma ba ltar na/ rang sa'i ro myang gi sred pa dang bral ba'i cha nas rnam thar dang*/ de dang 'dres pa'i cha nas snyoms 'jug tu 'jog go /de yang rnam thar dang po gsum ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i ngo bor skyes pas khyab/ gzugs med bzhi'i snyoms 'jug la yang rang gi dngos gzhis khyab pa yin te/ gzugs med kyi nyer bsdogs rnams ni rang sa la sred pa'i sgo nas der 'phen byed yin pa'i phyir/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug la ni rnam thar gyis khyab pa yin no// bzhi pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la/ 'phags rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gzugs med bzhi dang*/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang dgu/ 'dir byang sems thabs la mkhas pa'i dbang du byas pas 'das lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i srid rtse'i snyoms 'jug kyang yod do// 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug kyang mngon pa dang mthun par byed na/ snyoms par 'jug pa na 'das lam kho nas 'jug pas 'das lam du bzhag go /'dir 'gog snyoms gyi rnam par bzhag pa la/ nyan thos kyi lugs dang*/ theg chen gyi lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ dgag gzhi lus kyi steng du dgag bya rnam shes tshogs drug gam/ tshogs bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa bkag pa'i snyoms 'jug rdzas yod kyi ngo bor skyes pa'i ldan pa min pa'i 'du byed/ gnyis pa la/ theg chen thun mong ba'i lugs dang thun mong min pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ dgag gzhi kun gzhi'i steng du zhi gnas khyad par can srid rtse'i sems dang*/ lhag mthong khyad par can 'das lam gnyis/ dgag bya rnam shes tshogs bdun 'khor dang bcas pa bkag pa'i gnas skabs la btags pa'i ldan pa min pa'i 'du byed/ 'di la snyoms par 'jug pa po ni phyir mi 'ong lus mngon byed dang*/ dgra bcom gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol gyi snyoms par 'jug

byang sems ni theg chen gyi mthong lam nas snyoms par 'jug pa'i nus pa thob la/ de yang gzhan don du shes par bya ba'i phyir du snyoms par 'jug pa yin gyi/ rang don du mngon du bya ba'i phyir du ni min no// sangs rgyas kyis ni 'gog snyoms 'di la snyoms par 'jug pa med de de'i dgag gzhi med pa'i phyir/ 'dir snyoms 'jug tu bshad kyang ting 'dzin dngos min te/ ldan min 'du byed du bshad pa'i phyir/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi mnyam par bsgrub pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i sems kyis thob pa'i phyir/ snyoms 'jug ces bya'o// 'di'i gnas skabs na yid kyi shes pa mi gsal ba'i ngo bor yod par 'dod pa yang mi 'thad de/ de btsun pa dbyig shes kyi 'dod par byas nas theg bsdus su bkag pa'i phyir/ 'di mi rtog ye shes kyi ngo bor 'dod pa yang mi 'thad de theg bsdus dang*/ rgyal sras ma las/ rtog dpyod nye bar zhi bas mi rtog ye shes su 'jog na/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug kyang der 'gyur ro zhes de yin pa bkag pa'i phyir ro// 'di srid rtse'i sems kho nas thob dgos par bshad pa yang der brtson pa'i tshe yin gyi phyis ni der ma nges te/ yum gyi mdo las sa dgu'i sems la brten pa cig yod par bshad pa'i phyir/ dgag bya tshogs bdun 'gog par bshad pa yang 'dod pa khams kyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ de kho na ltar ma nges te/ khams gong ma gnyis su sna lce'i rnam par shes pa gnyis dgag mi dgos pa'i phyir/ ci yang med la chags bral byas par bshad pa yang spyir btang ba yin gyi/ dmigs gsal la de mi dgos par rgyal sras ma las bshad cing 'dod gzugs kho na'i rten du bshad pa yang kun gyi rnam par ma bzhag pa'i dbang du byas par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las bshad do// theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs la dgag gzhi de bzhin nyid kyi steng du/ dgag bya spros pa'i tshogs mtha' dag bkag pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/

'di sa dang po nas thob la/ drug pa nas mngon du 'gyur ba yin no// rang gi ngos skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon la gnod byed kyi mkhyen pa de spong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na bzod pa bzhi'o// sangs rgyas su bgrod pa'i go skabs phye shul du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa de sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ sbyin sogs pha rol du phyin pa bcu'o// bshad ma thag pa'i sprul pa'i lam sogs de dag la/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i mtshan nyid shes par 'dod na/ mtshan nyid kyi zur du byang sems kyi mkhyen pa sbyor/ skabs 'dir ni dngos gzhan dang bsgom bya shes rnam gnyis ka byang sems kyi mkhyen pa yin la/ snga ma byang phyogs so bdun 'chad pa'i skabs su/ dngos gzhan nyan rang dang*/ bsgom bya shes rnam byang sems kyi mkhyen pa yin la/ de gnyis ka'i skabs su sangs rgyas kyi so bdun dang po bzhis mtshon nas bstan pa la khyad par med do// gnyis pa mthun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gang zhig rang gi rigs 'dra mtshan nyid pa 'phags chung 'og ma'i rgyud la med pa de/ thun mong min pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ brten pa yon tan gyi dbye ba dang*/ rten ye shes kyi rang bzhin gnyis/ dang po la/ sde tshan bzhi las/ bsam gtan gyi rab mtha' la brten nas shes bya ma lus pa mngon sum du mkhyen pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes de/ stobs kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na bcu/ 'dir stobs bcu po thun mong min pa'i rnam par bshad kyang*/ de gang rung yin na de yin pas ma khyab ste/ sangs rgyas kyi dran pa nyer gzhag kyang de'i stobs yin pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi rab mtha' la brten nas 'khor gyi dbus su dam bca' 'jog pa la chos mthun gyi rgol ba med cing*/ chos mi mthun gyi rgol bar mi nus pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa de mi 'jigs pa'i mtshan nyid/

de la dbye na bzhi/ bsam gtan gyi rab mtha' la brten nas bshad bya dang 'chad byed thogs med du mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de so sor yang dag par rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na bzhi/ mdo las ma 'dres pa'i ming gis dngos su bstan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de/ ma 'dres pa'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ spyod pa ma 'dres pa drug rtogs pa ma 'dres pa drug 'phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum/ ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum mo// gnyis pa rten ye shes kyi rang bzhin bshad pa la gsum las/ chos nyid ji lta ba mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug de/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ ji snyed pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug de/ rang byung gi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ ji lta ji snyed kyi chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i mkhyen pa de sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dir bsgom bya dngos ni byang sems kyi thugs rgyud la yod pa'i stobs la sogs pa rjes mthun pa rnams la 'dod dgos so// gnyis pa sgom pa po'i gang zag gis bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor bshad pa la/ sgom pa po'i gang zag bshad pa dang*/ bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor bshad pa'o// dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ phyi nang gi mthun rkyen khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i sgo nas yum nyan pa'i snod du rung ba'i sems dpa' de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na yum nyan pa'i snod/ 'dzin pa'i snod/ don la mi brjed par sems pa'i snod/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa'i snod dang bzhi/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor la/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba dngos dang*/ sngon 'gro'i chos gnyis/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems pa'i rnal 'byor de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga ste nyi shu'o// sa mtshams ni tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do// gnyis pa sngon 'gro'i chos la/

blang bar bya ba yon tan dang*/ dor bar bya bar skyon gnyis/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba bsgom pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu bzhi/ sa mtshams tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba bsgom pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i chos de/ theg chen sbyor ba'i skyon gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na zhe drug sa mtshams sa bdun pa man chad na yod/ gnyis pa theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid la/ theg chen sbyor ba mtshon byed dang*/ theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan gzhi gang rung du dmigs pa de theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ las sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid gnyis/ theg chen sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon byed de/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ de la ming gi sgo nas dbye na/ theg chen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan/ khyad mtshan/ byed mtshan dang gsum/ theg chen sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon byed gang zhig mdo las shes pa zhe brgyad kyis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de dang po'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la ming gi sgo nas dbye na/ gzhi shes sbyor ba'i/ lam shes sbyor ba'i/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan dang gsum/ gzhi shes sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng gi thun mong min par mtshon byed gang zhig mdo las de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba sogs shes pa bcu drug gis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na bcu drug lhag ma gnyis kyang des bsgre bar bya'o// theg chen gyi sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon byed gang zhig mdo las khyad chos bcu drug gis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de theg chen sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan gyi mtshan nyid/

dbye na bcu drug yang de gang zhig mdo las byed pa bcu gcig gis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ theg chen sbyor ba'i byed mtshan gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu gcig go /bcu gcig po yang gsum du 'du ste/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i byed pa gsum/ lam shes sbyor ba'i byed pa bdun/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i byed pa gcig go /theg chen sbyor ba rang gi mtshan nyid kyis mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan nyid de/ las sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan gzhi'i mtshan nyid ces kyang bya la/ theg chen sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid mtshan gyi mtshan nyid ces kyang bya'o// de la dbye na/ gzhi shes sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid bzhi/ lam shes sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid lnga/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid bdun no// mdor na/ de dag mtshan gzhir bzhag nas rim pa bzhin du zab pa dang*/ gting dpag dka' ba dang*/ tshad med pa'i sbyor ba gsum du mtshon pa la/ gzhi lam rnam gsum la dmigs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ byed pa gsum dang*/ bdun dang*/ gcig dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mtshan nyid du sbyor zhing*/ de dag mtshan gzhir bzung nas/ theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mtshon pa la/ theg chen sbyor ba thun mong min par mtshon byed ces sogs mtshon sbyor gyi rnam gzhag rigs pas brtags nas shes par bya'o// bye brag tu khyad mtshan gyi mtshon tshul ni/ gting dpag dka' ba dang tshad med pa gnyis mtshan gzhir bzung nas/ theg dman las khyad par du 'phags pa'i theg chen sbyor bar mtshon pa la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mtshan nyid du bzung bar bya'o// 'dir mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba dang*/ zab pa'i sbyor ba sogs ni mtshon bya rnam grangs pa yin la/ de yang gzugs sogs gang zag gi bdag med pas zab pa dang*/ chos kyi bdag med pas gting dpag dka' ba dang*/

bdag gnyis kas stong pas tshad med pa zhes bya'o// gnyis pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba rgyud la skyes pa'i go rim bshad pa la/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba tsam sku gsum so sor ma phye ba'i rgyur bsgom pa'i tshul dang*/ sbyor ba khyad par can sku gsum 'phrin las dang bcas pa so sor nges pa'i rgyur bsgom pa'i tshul lo// dang po la/ sbyor ba tsam ngos bzung ba dang*/ rten gyi gang zag phyir mi ldog pa'i phan yon gyi sgo nas bshad pa'o// dang po la/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don la dbang thob phyir du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ tshogs lam gyi rnam rdzogs sbyor ba dang*/ sbyor lam gyi rnam rdzogs sbyor ba gnyis/ dang po la/ skabs 'dir thar pa cha mthun zhes bya zhing*/ de'i mtshan nyid ni/ shes rab kyis chos bden pa'i mtshan ma med par shes shing*/ thabs kyis sbyin sogs kyi dge rtsa rang rgyud la bskyed par mkhas pa'i theg chen las dang po'i mngon rtogs de theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa la ni/ 'dir nges 'byed cha mthun gyi ming gis bstan la/ rjes thob gtso bor gyur pa'i byang sems kyi nges 'byed cha mthun de/ 'dir bstan gyi nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bzhi'o// gnyis pa rten gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag la rnam rdzogs sbyor ba rgyud la skyes pas gnas skabs rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob pa'i rgyal sras de/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na sbyor lam pa/ mthong lam pa/ sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag dang gsum/ skabs 'dir rtags kyi rnam par gzhag pa la/ byang sems sbyor lam pa gnas skabs bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog tu bsgrub pa'i tshul gsum tshang ba de/ ma nges pa'i rigs can gyi sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags kyi mtshan nyid/

de ni dper na/ ma nges pa'i rigs can gyi byang sems sbyor lam pa dbang rnon chos can/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa yin te/ gzugs sogs la bden zhen mngon gyur ba ldog pa'i rjes thob kyi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i phyir/ zhes dang de chos can/ snying rje chen po dang ldan te/ rjes thob tu gzhan gyi don du dmyal ba yang 'tshol ba'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu 'bras bu'i rtags dang de chos can/ theg pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes rgyud la 'byung du rung ba yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyu tshogs grangs tshang ba'i phyir/ zhes pa rang bzhin gyi rtags so// gnyis pa la/ sku gsum so sor nges pa'i rgyu sbyor ba bshad pa dang*/ 'phrin las kyi rgyu thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba bshad pa'o// dang po la/ chos sku'i rgyu srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba dang*/ gzugs sku'i rgyu zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba'o// gtso bor chos kyi sku'i don du srid zhi rang bzhin med par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs nas bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams la srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba tsam ni sbyor lam nas yod la/ sa brgyad pa nas mngon du 'gyur ba yin no// rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi phung po gang rung gi ngo bor skyes pa de 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid/ las nyon ma lus par spangs pa'i so sor brtags 'gog de myang 'das kyi mtshan nyid yin no// gnyis pa la/ gtso bor gzugs kyi sku'i zhing sbyangs pa'i don du phyin drug nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ rang nyid gang du sangs rgyas pa'i zhing de'i snod kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ bcud kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba gnyis/ sa mtshams la tsam ni sbyor lam nas yod la/ khyad par can sa dgu pa nas mngon du gyur pa yin no// gtso bor 'phrin las phun sum tshogs pa'i ched du stong pa nyid la sogs pa'i yul rnam pa bcu mngon du bya ba'i dus dang dus min pa shes pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid dang*/

sogs khong na rnam thar sgo gsum dang*/ byang phyogs so bdun la sde tshan bdun du byas pa rnams 'don no// dbye na/ dgra las 'das pa la sogs pa'i thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba bcu/ bdud bzhi ma lus par spangs pa'i dbyings mngon du bya ba'i dus dang dus min pa shes pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi rnal 'byor de dgra las 'das pa'i thabs mkhas sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid zhes sogs sbyar bar bya'o// 'dir thabs mkhas ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la bya la/ de la ldog pa'i sgo nas dbye na bcu/ bcu po mngon sum du bya ba'i dus dang dus min pa shes pa'i rnal 'byor de la sbyor ba zhes bya'o// zhar la bdud bzhi'i ngo bo dang*/ spangs pa'i sa mtshams la/ nyer len pa'i phung po de phung po'i bdud kyi mtshan nyid/ khams gsum pa'i las nyon gang rung de nyon mongs pa'i bdud kyi mtshan nyid/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis rang dbang med par 'chi ba'i ngor skyes pa de/ 'chi bdag gi bdud kyi mtshan nyid/ bdud gzhan gsum las 'da' ba la bar du gcod byed gang zhig 'dod lha'i rigs su rtogs pa de lha'i bu'i bdud kyi mtshan nyid/ bcom pa'i sa mtshams la/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam nas lha'i bu'i bdud bcom/ byang sems kyi mthong lam nas nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang*/ 'chi bdag gi bdud gnyis bcom/ sa brgyad pa nas phung po'i bdud kyang bcom mo// de dag ni rags pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ sangs rgyas pa dang bdud bzhi ma lus par spangs pa dus mnyam mo// rnam pa brgya dang bdun cu gsum// rnam kun rdzogs par byang chub pa'i// rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i chos rnams ni// rnam mang mdo dang gzhung bzhin bshad// ces bya ba ni skabs bzhi pa'i lus dang yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o// //sgyu ma'i mdzad pa stong phrag mang po yis// sgyu ma'i 'gro ba 'di dag 'dun mdzad nas// sgyu ma'i rang bzhin gsal ba ston mdzad pa/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po bcom ldan der phyag 'tshal// gnyis pa dbang thob pa'i tshul gyis bsgom pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba la/

so sor skye bo'i rtse sbyor dang*/ 'phags pa'i rtse sbyor gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig nges 'byed cha mthun gyi ngo bor skyes pa/ dbye na bzhi las/ mdo las rtags bcu gnyis kyis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de rtags kyi rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni drod kyi rtse sbyor dang don gcig rtags bcu gnyis kyi rnam gzhag la/ mdo las dang po drug la rmi lam gyi rtags su gsung zhing*/ bdun pa la rmi lam dang sad rmi 'dam kha can du mdzad/ lhag ma rnams la yang sad rmi gnyis ka'i gsal ka ma mdzad do// buddha shrī ni dang po drug rmi lam gyi rtags/ de nas gnyis sad rmi gnyis ka'i rtags/ tha ma bzhi sad pa'i rtags su bzhed/ chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis dang po drug rmi lam gyi rtags dang*/ phyi ma drug sad pa'i rtags su bzhed/ lo tsā ba chen pos dang po brgyad 'bras rtags dang*/ phyi ma bzhi rang bzhin gyi rtags su bzhed/ mdo las rnam 'phel bcu drug gis mtshon nas dngos su bstan pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ rnam 'phel rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni rtse mo'i rtse sbyor dang don gcig mdo las brtan pa bcu gnyis kyis dngos su mtshon pas bstan pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ nges par brtan pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni bzod pa'i rtse sbyor dang gcig mdo las rjes su yi rang gis mtshon pas dngos su bstan pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ sems kun tu gnas pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni chos mchog gi rtse sbyor dang don gcig gnyis pa 'phags pa'i rtse sbyor la/ shes sgrib rags pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i rtse sbyor dang*/

gnas ngan len gyi dri ma phra zhing phra ba'i gnyen por gyur pa'i rtse sbyor gnyis/ dang po la/ mthong lam rtse sbyor dang*/ sgom lam rtse sbyor gnyis/ dang po la/ spang bya rtog pa bshad pa dang*/ gnyen po mthong lam rtse sbyor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ yul gyi gnas tshul la ji lta ba bzhin ma yin par zhen pa'i blo gang zhig kun btags kyi char gyur pa de mthong spangs rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na mthong spangs su gyur pa'i gzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog gnyis/ rtog pa kun btags gang zhig yul gzung ba la dmigs nas gzung bar zhen pa'i blo de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ mthong spangs su gyur pa'i 'jug pa gzung rtog dang*/ ldog pa gzung rtog gnyis/ rtog pa kun btags gang zhig dmigs yul theg chen gyi chos la dmigs nas 'jug byar zhen pa'i blo de mthong spangs su gyur pa'i 'jug pa gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na dgu/ kun btags su gyur pa'i rtog pa gang zhig dmigs yul theg dman gyi chos la dmigs nas ldog byar zhen pa'i blo de/ mthong spangs su gyur pa'i ldog pa gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na dgu/ kun btags su gyur pa'i rtog pa gang zhig yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas 'dzin par mngon par zhen pa'i blo de mthong spangs 'dzin rtog gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ mthong spangs su gyur pa'i rtog pa gang zhig yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas rdzas yod kyi 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ gang zag la rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ chos la rdzas 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ mthong spangs su gyur pa'i 'dzin rtog gang zhig gang zag la dmigs nas rdzas yod kyi 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na dgu/ de gang zhig gdags gzhir gyur pa'i phung po la dmigs nas rdzas yod kyi 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na dgu/

mthong spangs su gyur pa'i rtog pa gang zhig yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas btags pa tsam gyis 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de mthong spangs rtag 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na skyes bu la rtag 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ chos la rtag 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ de gang zhig yul skyes bu tsam la dmigs nas btags pa tsam gyis 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig yul skyes bu'i gdags gzhir gyur pa'i phung po lnga la dmigs nas btags pa tsam gyis 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na dgu// 'dir skye 'phags gnyis pa la so sor nges par bshad pa ni mthong spangs su gyur pa'i gang zag la rdzas 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang*/ gang zag la rtag 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ chos la rdzas 'dzin gyi dbang du byas pa min no// gnyis pa la/ nyer len gyi rgyu mthong lam rtse sbyor gyis spang bya rtog pa spangs pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i nyer len can gyi 'bras bu bshad pa dang*/ nyer len gyi rgyu mthong lam rtse sbyor nyid bshad pa'o// dang po la/ lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen bshad pa dang*/ 'bras bu byang chub chen po dngos bshad pa'o// rang 'bras byang chub chen po'i nyer len gyi rgyu'i nus pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa'i rkyen gyis byang chub chen po lhan cig byed rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ gzhan 'bras bu rtogs pa'i chos la 'god pa/ rgyu lung gi chos la 'god pa/ rang byang chub kyi rgyu la sbyor ba dang gsum/ gnyis pa byang chub chen po la dngos dang*/ zhar la rnal 'byor sa bzhi bshad pa'o// dang po la/ byang chen tsam dang*/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i byang chen gnyis/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum la bya ste/ ji skad du/ sku gsum dag gi byang chub che// zhes bya ba'i phyir ro// dri ma zad skye bden pa med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/

'dir dngos su bstan pa'i byang chen ni mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi nyer len yin pa'i phyir/ ye shes kho na'i cha nas bshad pa la 'gal ba med do// gnyis pa la theg chen gyi zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi rnal 'byor de 'dir bstan gyi rnal 'byor sa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa/ gzung med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa/ 'dzin med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa/ spros bral rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa dang bzhi/ skye 'jig can gyi rtags la brten nas nyer len gyi phung po bdag med du rtogs nas bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams tshogs lam nas yod do// lhan cig dmigs nges kyi rtags la brten nas gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis stong par rtogs nas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams sbyor lam drod nas so// phyi don bden par med pa'i rtags kyis de la ltos pa'i 'dzin pa bdag med du rtogs nas bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzod pa nas so// rten 'brel gyi rtags la brten nas gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi shes pa bdag med du rtogs nas bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams la tsam gyi dbang du byas na dbu ma pa'i sbyor lam nas yod la/ khyad par can gyi dbang du byas na/ byang sems kyi mthong lam nas so// gnyis pa la/ spong lam bshad pa dang*/ khyad par gyi lam bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig mthong spangs kyi sa bon la dngos su gnod byed kyi mkhyen pa de mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dngos btags ma phye ba'i sgo nas dbye na/ sbyor ba nyer bsdogs dang*/ 'jug pa bar chad med lam gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/

mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa'i mthong spangs kyi sa bon la cha shas su phye nas gnod pa byed cing drungs 'byin mi nus pa/ de ni byang sems kyi sbyor lam chos mchog gi ye shes lta bu'o// de gang zhig der gyur pa'i de'i sa bon rnams bsdoms nas drungs 'byin nus pa de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod lta bu'o// gnyis pa khyad par gyi lam la mnyam gzhag seng ge rnam bsgyings dang*/ rjes thob rten 'brel la rtog tshul gnyis/ mthong lam gyi khyad par gyi lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na dgu/ mthong lam gyi rjes thob la gnas pa'i sems pa'i rgyud kyi rten 'brel lugs 'byung dang*/ lugs ldog tu rtog par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de 'dir bstan gyi rjes thob rten 'brel la rtog pa'i rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid/ 'dir rten 'brel gyi rnam par gzhag pa la/ g.yo ba med pa dang*/ mi rtag pa dang*/ nus pa'i rkyen gsum las byung ba de rten 'brel tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan nyid dang pos rgyu med yin pa bsal/ gnyis pas rgyu rtag pa las skye ba bsal/ gsum pas rigs mi mthun las skye ba bsal/ de yang mdo las 'di yod pas 'di 'byung*/ 'di skyes pa'i phyir 'di skye/ 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed rnams so// zhes sogs tshig gsum gsungs pa'i don dang sbyar ro// de la dbye na/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi rten 'brel dang*/ rnam byang gi rten 'brel gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal skye ba'i rim pa de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ ma rig pa nas rga shi'i bar bcu gnyis so// 'di la spyir ngos gzung ba dang*/

bye brag tu gang zag gcig gi rten 'brel bcu gnyis ngos gzung ba'o// dang po la/ rig pa ye shes kyi 'gal zlar gyur pa'i sems byung rmongs pa de ma rig pa tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na nyon mongs pa can gyi ma rig pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa can min pa'i ma rig pa gnyis/ phyi ma ni 'dir mi gzung la/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ de gang zhig yang srid 'phen byed kyi las kun nas slong bar nus pa/ de la dbye na/ las 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi don la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa gnyis las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam dbye mi shes pa'i sems byung rmongs pa gang zhig bsod nams min pa'i las kun nas slong byed de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de kho na nyid kyi don mi shes pa'i sems byung rmongs pa gang zhig bsod nams dang mi g.yo ba'i las kun nas slong byed de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ yang ma rig pa la dbye na/ rgyu'i kun slong du gyur pa'i ma rig pa dang*/ dus kyi kun slong du gyur pa'i ma rig pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'phen byed kyi las kun slong gi ma rig pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ 'grub byed kyi las kun slong gi ma rig pa lta bu'o// yang ma rig pa la dbye na/ mthong spangs su gyur pa'i ma rig pa dang*/ sgom spangs su gyur pa'i ma rig pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ yid shes 'khor du byung ba'i ma rig pa kun btags lta bu yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ nyon yid 'khor gyi ma rig pa lta bu la bya'o// ma rig pas kun nas bslang ba'i zag bcas kyi las de 'dir bstan 'du byed kyi rten 'brel gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bsod nams kyi las/ bsod nams min pa'i las/ mi g.yo ba'i las dang gsum/ de la yang 'phen byed kyi las dang*/ 'grub byed kyi las gnyis gnyis yod do// las kyi bag chags bsgos pa'i rnam shes de 'dir stan rnam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ 'di la rgyu dus kyi rnam shes dang*/ 'bras dus kyi rnam shes gnyis/

dang po ni/ las sog pa'i dus kyi rnam shes la bya/ gnyis pa ni nying mtshams sbyar ba'i dus kyi rnam shes la bya/ de yang kun gzhi bzhed pa ltar na/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes la bya/ mi bzhed pa ltar na yid kyi rnam shes la bya'o// rang rgyu las kyi bag chags bsgos pa'i rnam shes las 'byung zhing*/ nur nur po la sogs pa'i gzugs phung dang por grub pa'i gnas skabs kyi phung po lnga po gang rung de rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i ming gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dir ming ni/ tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes 'du byed/ rnam par shes pa dang bzhi la bya/ gzugs ni nur nur po nas skye mched drug ma dod pa'i bar gyi lus la bya'o// rang rgyu ming dang gzugs las 'byung zhing*/ skye mched drug dang por tshang ba'i gnas skabs kyi skye mched de/ 'dir bstan skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ mig gi skye mched sogs drug rang rgyu yul dbang yid byed gsum 'dus pa la brten nas yul yid du 'ong mi 'ong bar ma gsum gang rung du spyod par byed pa'i sems byung de/ bcu gnyis kyi cha shas su gyur pa'i reg pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa sogs drug rang rgyu reg pas yul gsum gang rung du yongs su spyad pa las sim gdung bar ma gsum gang rung gi ngo bor nyams su myong ba'i sems byung de/ bcu gnyis kyi cha shas su gyur pa'i tshor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba sogs drug rang rgyu tshor ba'i rkyen can gyi bde sdug btang snyoms gsum la blang dor bya bar 'dod pa'i sred pa de/ bcu gnyis kyi cha shas su gyur pa'i sred pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ 'dod sred/ gzugs sred/ gzugs med kyi sred pa dang gsum/ de yang tshor ba sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa na/ de dang bral bar 'dod pa'i sred pa dang*/ bde ba thob par 'dod pa'i sred pa skye/

de la yang gsum ste/ 'dod yon la sred pa'i sred pa lta bu 'dod sred/ bsam gtan dang po gsum gyi bde ba dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i btang snyoms la sred pa/ gzugs kyi sred pa/ gzugs med kyi tshor ba btang snyoms la sred pa ni gzugs kyi sred pa'o// sred pa de nyid shes cher 'phel ba'i sems byung 'dod chags de/ 'dir bstan len pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ 'dod pa nye bar len pa/ lta ba nye bar len pa/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs nye bar len pa/ bdag tu smra ba nye bar len pa dang bzhi/ rang rgyu len pa'i rkyen gyis yang srid 'grub byed kyi las nus pa mthu can de 'dir bstan srid pa'i mtshan nyid/ spyir srid pa tsam gyi ming can mang du bshad kyang*/ srid pa 'di la dbye ba ma bshad do// sred len gnyis la yang rgyu'i kun slong gnyis/ dus kyi kun slong gnyis ka yod la/ srid pa la yang 'phen 'grub kyi cha gnyis ka yod do// las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis yang srid phyi mar nying mtshams sbyar ba'i phung po de 'dir bstan gyi skye ba'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ mngal nas skye ba dang*/ sgo nga las skye ba/ drod gsher las skye ba/ rdzus nas skye ba dang bzhi'o// las nyon gyi dbang gis na tshod gzhan dang gzhan du 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs de 'dir bstan rga shi'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na rga ba dang 'chi ba gnyis/ gnyis pa 'gro ba gcig gi rten 'brel bye brag tu bshad pa la/ mi lta bu'i 'gro ba gcig tu 'phen par byed pa'i las kun nas slong byed kyi ma rig pa de/ mi lta bu'i rten 'brel tshar gcig gi dbang du byas pa'i ma rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu ma rig pa'i dbang gis mi lta bu'i 'gro ba rigs mthun gcig tu 'phags pa'i zag bcas kyi las de/ mi lta bu'i rten 'brel tshar gcig gi dbang du byas pa'i 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid/ ma rig pa'i dbang gis mir 'phen byed kyi las kyi bag chags bsgos pa'i rnam shes de/

rten 'brel tshar gcig gi rnam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dir ni rgyu dus kyi rnam shes kho na la 'dod dgos so// mir 'phen byed kyi las kyi bag chags bsgos pa'i rnam shes de'i steng gi mi lta bu'i 'gro ba 'byung rung gi nus pa de/ mi lta bu'i rten 'brel tshar gcig gi ming gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ de bzhin du mtshan mtshon gnyis ka la sbyar nas/ de'i steng gi mi lta bu'i 'gro ba gcig gi yang srid phyi ma'i skye mched drug 'byung rung gi nus pa de skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ de'i steng gi yul yongs su gcod par byed pa'i reg pa 'byung rung gi nus pa de reg pa'i mtshan nyid/ de'i steng gi mi lta bu'i 'gro ba rigs mthun gcig gis tshor ba 'byung rung gi nus pa de de'i tshor ba'i mtshan nyid/ mi lta bu'i bde ba la sred pa'i sgo nas mir 'grub byed kyi las kun nas slong byed de de'i sred pa'i mtshan nyid/ mi lta bu'i 'gro ba gcig gi tshor ba bde ba'i rgyu len par byed pa'i sgo nas mir 'grub byed kyi las sog par byed pa de de'i len pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu sred len gyi dbang gis 'du byed nas tshor ba'i bar gyi nus pa mthu can du byas pa'i zag bcas kyi las de de'i srid pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu las nyon gyi dbang gis ma'i skye gnas su nying mtshams sbyar ba'i gnas skabs kyi phung po de/ mi'i rten 'brel tshar gcig gi skye ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'di la ming gzugs nas tshor ba'i bar lnga'o// de yang snga ma dang khyad par yod de/ 'dir ni de dag mngon du gyur pa'i gnas skabs yin pa'i phyir/ rang rgyu las nyon gyi dbang gis mi lta bu'i skye gnas su skyes pa'i phung po'i rgyun gzhan dang gzhan du 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs de de'i rga shi'i mtshan nyid/ de ltar bcu gnyis po thams cad rgyu 'bras tshar gcig gi dbang du byas nas 'chad pa 'di ni/

thogs med sku mched kyi thun mong min pa'i lugs yin la/ gzhung gzhan la rgyu 'bras tshar gnyis kyi dbang du byas nas bshad pa de ni/ mi lta bu'i rten 'brel dang*/ de nas lhar skye ba lta bu'i rten 'brel bsres pa'i rnam gzhag yin no// 'o na mdo las sred pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba 'byung bar gsungs pa dang*/ rten 'brel tshar gcig pa'i lugs 'di 'gal te/ lugs 'di la ming gzugs sogs grub pa la sred len srid pa gsum sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir zhe na nyes pa med de/ de 'grub pa la de sngon du 'gro dgos su zin kyang 'phangs pa'i yan lag tu bzhag pa'i tshor ba 'byung rung gi nus pa de la sred pa mngon gyur pa 'byung ba mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ de ltar 'gro ba gcig gi rten 'brel bcu gnyis po de yang 'gro ba rigs mi mthun pa gsum ma gnyis kyi rten la rdzogs dgos pa yin te/ 'dod pa'i lha lta bu'i rten la mir 'phen byed kyi las bsags/ dud 'gro lta bu'i rten la mir 'phen byed kyi las bsags/ 'grub byed kyi las mngon du gyur nas mir skye dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dir sa mtshungs dpyad pa la/ yan lag bcu gnyis po 'di sa mtshungs sam mi mtshungs she na/ yan lag dang po dang rnam shes ni gang du la sogs pa'i sa de kho nar gtogs pa yin te/ sku mched gnyis kyis ma rig pa ni nyon yid 'khor gyi ma rig pa dang*/ rnam par shes pa rgyu dus kyi kun gzhi nyid bshad pa'i phyir/ 'jug shes 'khor gyi ma rig pa dang*/ 'bras dus kyi rnam shes la 'dod pa'i lugs la ni/ rnam bshad las gsungs pa ltar ro// 'du byed la sogs pa'i bcu po de ni sa mtshungs pa kho na yin te/ sa gzhan gyi las kyis sa gzhan gyi phung po 'phen zhing*/ 'grub par byed mi nus pa'i phyir dang*/ sa gzhan gyi las gsos 'debs byed kyi nyon mongs pas sa gzhan gyi las gsos 'debs mi nus pa'i phyir/

'o na gong ma'i rten la 'dod pa'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ mi dge ba yod par thal/ gzugs khams nas ngan song du skye ba'i tshe sred len srid pa gsum po ngan song du gtogs dgos pa'i phyir ro// zhe na nyes pa med de/ gong ma'i dngos gzhi'i sems las nyams pa'i gong sa'i rten las 'og ma'i nyon mongs 'byung ba 'dod pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ don gsang rnam par bshad pa las/ skye ba'i sa pa gang yin pa mngon par 'grub par byed pa'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ nges par de'i sa pa'o zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa sgom lam rtse sbyor la sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi spangs bya rtog pa ji ltar spongs ba'i tshul dang*/ des spangs pas thob pa'i brten pa yon tan bshad pa'o// dang po la/ gnyen po sgom lam rtse sbyor dang*/ spangs bya rtog pa gnyis/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig sgom spangs rtog pa'i sa bon la gnod byed kyi mkhyen pa de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings dang*/ dngos gzhi thod rgal gnyis/ mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu la chos gzhan spel bar gang yang med par lugs mthun dang lugs mi mthun gnyis kyi sgo nas snyoms par 'jug pa'i snyoms 'jug de/ seng ge rnam bsgyings kyi ting nge 'dzin tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ mthong lam gyi skabs nas bstan pa'i khyad par gyi lam gyi ngo bor skyes pa'i seng ge rnam bsgyings dang*/ sgom lam gyi skabs nas bstan pa'i spong lam gyi ngo bor skyes pa'i sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings gnyis/ dang po ni bshad zin la/ seng ge rnam bsgyings gang zhig rang gi ngos skal gyi spang bya sgom spangs kyi sa bon la cha shas re re nas gnod par byed cing*/ drungs 'byin mi nus pa de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni/ 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur/ rnam pa gnyis su song*/

zhes pa'i gzhung gis bstan pa yin no// rang rgyu sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings sngon du btang nas mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu la lugs mthun dang lugs mi mthun gang rung gi sgo nas snyoms par 'jug pa'i snyoms 'jug gang zhig rang gi ngos skal gyi spang byar gyur pa'i sgom spangs kyi sa bon drungs 'byin nus pa de dngos gzhi thod rgal gyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ thod rgal chung ngu*/ 'bring*/ chen po gsum/ rang rgyu sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi thod rgal 'bring po ma skyes gong der mthar gnas gyi snyoms 'jug dgu la chos gzhan spel bor gang yang med par lugs mthun du snyoms par 'jug pa'i snyoms 'jug de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu dngos gzhi thod rgal chung ngu sngon du btang nas/ mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dang po brgyad dang 'gog pa spel te lugs mthun du snyoms par 'jug cing*/ 'gog pa nas srid rtse la nud chung byed pa'i snyoms 'jug de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyud dngos gzhi thod rgal 'bring po sngon du btang nas/ mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu dang 'dod sems spel te lugs mi mthun du snyoms par 'jug pa'i snyoms 'jug de gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ltar thod rgal chung ngu la gnas dgu/ 'bring po la bcu bdun/ chen po la bco brgyad/ sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings la bcu bdun rnams so// gnyis pa la/ yul gyi gnas tshul la phyin ci log tu zhugs pa'i blo gang zhig lhan skyes kyi char gyur pa de sgom spangs rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na bzhi/ de re re la'ang dgu dgu ste so drug de yang khams gsum du so sor phye bas brgya dang bco brgyad/ so so'i mtshan nyid ni/ lhan skyes shes sbyar ba ma gtogs/ mthong spangs kyi skabs bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o// gnyis pa la/ theg pa gsum gyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba'i 'gal rkyen mngon gyur pa zad cing mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa de sgom lam gyi brten pa yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/

sa mtshams ni sa bcu pa nas yod do// gnyis pa la/ dngos dang dmigs rnam gnyis/ dang po la/ rang 'bras rnam mkhyen skad cig dang po'i dngos rgyur gyur pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni rgyun mtha'i ye shes la bya'o// gnyis pa la/ dmigs rnam dngos dang*/ dmigs rnam la rtsod pa'i log sgrub gnyis/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi sgro 'dogs bcad par bya ba'i gzhi de de'i dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni bden stong sgyu ma lta bu la zer/ bar chad med lam pa'i rtse sbyor rang dbang du skyed byed de de'i bdag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ de ni rgyun mtha' man chad kyi dmigs rnam mi brjed pa'i dran pa la zer/ bar chad med rtses yul rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de de'i rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ de ni spros bral rtogs pa'i rgyun mtha'i ye shes la bya'o// zhar la de ma thag rkyen gyi rig pa snga ma la bya'o// de ni slob dpon gyi bzhed pa'o// 'phags pa ltar na/ stong gsum skye bo zhes pa'i skabs su/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor de rnam mkhyen gyi de ma thag rkyen du bstan nas/ rnam mkhyen gyi bdag rkyen dang dmigs rkyen ston byed du gzhung phyi ma gsungs par bzhed do// gnyis pa log sgrub la/ bden gnyis gang rung re re rgyu mtshan du byas nas cig shos sun 'byin ba'i log rtog gam/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i rtsod ngag gang rung de bar chad med rtse'i dmigs rnam la rtsod pa'i log sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ log rtog dang*/ rtsong ngag gnyis/ de re re la yang bcu drug bcu drug go /'di'i dang po ni/ bden gnyis rnam 'byed kyis sel la/ gnyis pa ni/ de la bstan pa'i lan gyis sel bar byed do// 'dir rtsod pa'i tshul la rnam pa bzhi ste/ kun rdzob rgyu mtshan du byas nas don dam sun 'byin par byed pa dang*/

don dam rgyu mtshan du byas nas kun rdzob sun 'byin par byed pa dang*/ kun rdzob rgyu mtshan du byas nas kun rdzob nyid sun 'byin par byed pa dang*/ don dam rgyu mtshan du byas nas don dam nyid sun 'byin par byed pa'o// dang po gsum gzhung las dngos su gsungs shing*/ phyi ma dngos su ma gsungs kyang don gyis thob bo// klan ka dang po la don dam gyi sgo nas lan 'debs/ gnyis pa la kun rdzob kyi sgo nas lan 'debs par gzhung las gsung la/ phyi ma gnyis la bden pa gnyis ka'i sgo nas lan 'debs par don gyis thob bo// rtse sbyor yan lag 'phros dang bcas// rtse bar yum gyi mdo dang ni// rtse gyur gzhung lugs mang po nas// rtse mo'i blo yis bsdus te bshad// ces bya ba ni skabs lnga pa'i lus dang yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o// //stong nyid mar gad zhu ba'i chu gter du// mngon rtogs shel dkar sbu ba 'dren 'dra ba'i// rgyal yum rgya mtsho'i snying po 'dren mdzad pa// mi pham srid zhi'i mes po der phyag 'tshal// gnyis pa brtan pa rgyu 'bras la/ rgyu mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ 'bras bu skad cig ma'i sbyor ba gnyis/ dang po la mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don la brtan pa thob phyir du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ lam gyi ngo bo phyin drug gi mthar gyis sbyor ba dang*/ lam khyad par du byed pa rjes dran drug gi mthar gyis sbyor ba dang*/ lam rnam par dag byed dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i mthar gyis sbyor ba dang gsum/ shes rnam brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum dang*/ phyin drug zung 'brel du nyams su len pa la brtan pa thob phyir du slob pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na drug las/ skye med gsum gyi shes rnam dang*/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin zung 'brel du nyams su len pa la slob pa'i sems dpa'i sems rnal 'byor de sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/
